shopping: Malibu(R) coconut rum|Sauza(R) tequila|Jose Cuervo(R) margarita mix|UV(R) cherry vodka|Hawaiian Punch(R)|Sunny Delight(R) orange juice

name: Nadir Cocktail
ingredients: 1 2/3 oz gin|1/3 oz cherry brandy|2/3 oz lemon juice|2/3 oz strawberry syrup|1/2 oz grenadine syrup|2 tsp pineapple juice|3 oz soda water
instructions: Pour the gin, cherry brandy, lemon juice, strawberry syrup, grenadine and pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes, and fill with soda water. Garnish with a slice of pineapple, and serve.
shopping: gin|cherry brandy|lemon juice|strawberry syrup|grenadine syrup|pineapple juice|soda water

name: Peppermint Cream
ingredients: 3/4 oz creme de menthe|3/4 oz white creme de cacao|3/4 oz Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|3/4 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1 oz milk
instructions: Pour the creme de menthe, white creme de cacao, Frangelico hazelnut liqueur and Bailey's irish cream into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with milk, to taste. Garnish with a piece of kiwi, add a straw, and serve.
shopping: creme de menthe|white creme de cacao|Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|Bailey's(R) Irish cream|milk

name: Coast Colada
ingredients: 1 oz Bacardi(R) white rum|3/4 oz Midori(R) melon liqueur|3 oz pina colada mix|1/3 fresh banana|1 1/2 scoops crushed ice
instructions: The Coast Colada recipe was made up by John Aquino at Coast Bar and Grille, Charleston, SC where it became their signature drink, and a popular one at that.Blend all ingredients together in a blender. Pour into a hurricane glass garnished with a slice of starfruit, and serve.
shopping: Bacardi(R) white rum|Midori(R) melon liqueur|pina colada mix|banana|crushed ice

name: Classic Cocktail
ingredients: 1 oz brandy|1 1/2 tsp Curacao orange liqueur|1 1/2 tsp maraschino liqueur|1 oz lemon juice
instructions: Prepare an old-fashioned glass by rubbing a slice of lemon around the rim and dipping it into powdered sugar. Pour the brandy, curacao, maraschino liqueur and lemon juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, strain into the prepared glass, and serve.

name: Fuzzy Slammers
ingredients: 1/2 oz Bacardi(R) white rum|1 squeezefresh lemon juice|1/2 oz Champagne
instructions: Fill half a shot glass with the Bacardi, add lemon juice and then add the champagne.^^^^Place hand over the top of the glass, slam the glass on the bar to release the bubbles and down the shot in one go. This is a great drink to start a party of with, the bubbles are amazing.

name: Rum a'la Olof
ingredients: 3 cl blended Rum|20 ml Lemon juice|50 ml Whipped cream|5 ml hot Coffee|5 gr Cocoa powder
instructions: Poure the rum and the lemon-juice in the bowl, and mix it. Then you take the cocoa-powder and the hot coffee and mix it with the other stuff in the bowl. After that you poure your mixture in a shot-glass. The whipped cream you put on the top of the glass. Ready to be served!

name: La Vida Loca
ingredients: 3 - 4 oz Absolut(R) pepper vodka|3 - 4 oz pineapple juice|1 - 2 tsp chili peppers
instructions: Cut the chili into small pieces. Put one or two teaspoons of chopped chili in the glass. Fill the glass with ice (not all the way up, gotta save some space for the vodka). Mix the ice and chili well. Pour vodka and pineapple juice in the glass, mix again. Serve with a straw.

name: Hyper-Active Apple
ingredients: 1 oz Caramel|1 shot Apple schnapps|2 shots Espresso|1 shot steamed Milk
instructions: In Irish coffee mug pour chilled caramel, then slowly pour one shot of chilled apple shnapps over caramel. Slowly add steamed milk, pour espresso through steamed milk exceedingly slowly, top with whip cream or foam. It should come out to be a 4 layer happily alcoholic Latte.

name: Axel
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|1 oz Roncoco(R) coconut liqueur|1 dash grenadine syrup
instructions: Add the vodka and Roncoco liqueur to a a cocktail shaker and shake with ice. Pour into a shot glass and top with a bit of grenadine. Drink the shot, cover the glass with your hand and with a straw, inhale the alcohol vapor that lasts in the shot (with your hand still on it).

name: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake Mar...
ingredients: 1 oz vanilla vodka|2 oz pineapple juice|1 dash grenadine syrup
instructions: The vanilla vodka lends the cake-like flavor to the juice. The grenadine sinks to the bottom. It even looks like a pineapple up-side-down cake.Shake pineapple juice and vanilla vodka with ice in a tumbler. Pour into a martini cocktail glass. Add dash of grenadine, and serve.

name: Cement Mixer #2
ingredients: 1/2 oz tequila|1/2 oz half-and-half
instructions: The Cement Mixer drinks are renowned for their ability to curdle when mixed together (mostly in your mouth). The contributor suggests you give it to a friend for a prank!Mix together the two ingredients in a shot glass, and serve. It's recommended you also chase with a beer.

name: Lulu
ingredients: 1/2 oz vodka|1/2 oz triple sec|1/2 oz white rum|1/2 oz amaretto almond liqueur|1/2 oz peach schnapps|1 oz sweet and sour mix|1 splash pineapple juice|1 splash grenadine syrup
instructions: Pour the vodka, triple sec, white rum, amaretto, peach schnapps, sour mix and pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a champagne saucer or medium-sized cocktail glass. Add a splash of grenadine, add a straw, and serve.
shopping: vodka|triple sec|white rum|amaretto almond liqueur|peach schnapps|sweet and sour mix|pineapple juice|grenadine syrup

name: Banana Splat
ingredients: 2-1/2 oz Banana liqueur|dash Chocolate liqueur (Godiva)|1/2 oz Creme de Cacao|3 oz Milk|1 splash Malibu rum|Whipped cream|1 dash Nutmeg
instructions: In blender, mix banana liquer, rum, chocolate liquer, creme de cacao and milk with ice and blend until smooth. Pour into either red wine glass or rocks glass, top with a dollop of whipped cream, sprinkle of nutmeg and a cherry on top. Use a VERY light touch with the Malibu.
shopping: Banana liqueur|Chocolate liqueur|Creme de Cacao|Milk|Malibu rum|Whipped cream|Nutmeg

name: Great Alexander
ingredients: 3/4  ice|3/4 shot Drambuie(R) Scotch whisky|3/4 shot blackberry brandy|1/2 shot sweet and sour mix|1/2 shot grenadine syrup
instructions: I Recently invented this drink last week since I didnt have one, and I just started bartending. My name being Alexander Theus, The Great Alexander seemed like a great name for a drink...But I made a point to try and incorporate my heritage into to it. I'm about 35% scottish
shopping: so the Drambuie takes care of more than enough...especially since my Grandfather lived till 78 years old and he drank scotch whisky every day of his life

name: Bullfrog (The Party Mix)
ingredients: 1/2 gal Vodka|1 pint Grain alcohol|2 L Ginger ale|2 L Lemon-lime soda|2 L Sprite|Juice of 2 Lemon|Juice of 2 Lime
instructions: Pour in the soda, and then add the Vodka. After mixing pour in the grain alcohol. Use a knife and cut the lemons and limes and squeeze the juice out of them. store bought lime and lemon juice can be substituted. Now you have a great party drink and should have a good night.

name: Bombay Safari
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Bombay Sapphire(R) gin|1 splash Rose's(R) lime juice|3 oz sweet and sour mix|3 oz tonic water
instructions: The bastard offspring of a gin & tonic and a Tom Collins. Created and frequently enjoyed by Scott Nelson, Instructor, American Bartending School, Westminster, CA USA.Build directly in a collins glass filled with ice cubes; do not shake. Garnish with a lime wedge, and serve.
shopping: Bombay Sapphire(R) gin|Rose's(R) lime juice|sweet and sour mix|tonic water

name: Southside
ingredients: 2 oz gin|1 oz simple syrup|3/4 ozfresh lime juice|3 - 4 oz soda water|2  mint|2 pieces limes
instructions: Muddle one sprig of mint with the lime pieces, lime juice, and simple syrup in the bottom of a bar glass. Add gin and shake well. Pour into a goblet over crushed ice and stir until the outer-glass frosts. Top with soda water, garnish with remaining sprig of mint, and serve.

name: Cerebral Hemorage
ingredients: 2 oz Strawberry schnapps|1/2 oz Bailey's irish cream|2 tsp Grenadine
instructions: Put the Strawberry Schnapps into a double shot or other small glass (this can all be performed in a single glass), then add the Bailey's. It will lump together (Bailey's, that is) to look like a brain in a red fluid (SS). Finally, add Grenadine until it oozes from the brain

name: Drill
ingredients: 4 oz vodka|1/3  Red Bull(R) energy drink|2/3  orange juice|ice cubes
instructions: Combine two boring drinks (redbull vodka and Screwdriver) and get one fantastic drink. Get rid of that dull orangejuice-taste and spice it up!^^^^Portion the juice and redbull as you want, but my fieldtesting has prooven this combination the best!^^^^Bottoms up from Norway!
shopping: vodka|Red Bull(R) energy drink|orange juice|ice cubes

name: Pineapple Julep
ingredients: 4 fresh mint|3 ripe pineapple|1 oz simple syrup|2 oz bourbon whiskey
instructions: Muddle the leaves from two sprigs of mint, with the pineapple wedges and simply syrup, in a mixing glass. Add bourbon and ice, and shake well. Strain into a highball glass filled with crushed ice, and stir well until frosted. Garnish with two further mint sprigs, and serve.

name: Long Island Taxi
ingredients: 2 oz vodka|1 oz gin|1 oz tequila|1 oz rum|orange juice
instructions: A popular cocktail at the Lakewood Lounge, Kansas City, Mo, where Long Island Taxi originated via a guy named Matt. Pour all liquors into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Add orange juice to taste, and shake. Strain into shot glasses or a single highball glass, and serve.

name: Jake's Bloody Mary
ingredients: 2 ozquality vodka|1 tsp dry sherry|1 1/2 oz lime juice|1 oz V8(R) vegetable juice|3 oz tomato juice|3 drops Tabasco(R) sauce|3 drops Worcestershire sauce|1 pinch celery salt|1 pinch peppers
instructions: Pour the vodka, dry sherry, lime juice, V8 juice and tomato juice into a beer pilsner over ice and mix well. Season as desired; roughly 3 drops of Tabasco sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Finish with a pinch of celery salt and pepper. Serve with a stick of celery or carrot.
shopping: vodka|dry sherry|lime juice|V8(R) vegetable juice|tomato juice|Tabasco(R) sauce|Worcestershire sauce|celery salt|peppers

name: Blood Mary Extra Hairy
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|1 tbsp lemon juice|8 oz tomato juice|1  celery|3 dashes black peppers|1 dash salt|1 pinch horseradish|1 tspdijon mustard|3 dashes Tabasco(R) sauce|2 dashes Worcestershire sauce
instructions: Shake all ingredients except celery in a martini shaker with ice. Strain into glass with ice and garnish with stalk of celery. Can optionally add olives, cocktail onions, or lemon/lime wedge. For a little lighter drink, cut this with a fourth to a half a can of light beer.

name: Irish Cream Liqueur #2
ingredients: 2 Egg|1 1/3 cup evaporated Milk|1/2 tsp Chocolate syrup|1 tblsp Vanilla extract|1/3 tsp Lemon juice extract|1/4 tsp instant Coffee|1/4 cup granulated Sugar|1 3/4 cup Irish whiskey
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender, blend well. Bottle and let mellow in refrigerator at least one week befor serving. this has been found to be best after 1-2 weeks. Store in refrigerator. Liqueur at room temperature by removing form refrigerator 1-2 hours before serving.

name: Four Horsemen #3
ingredients: 3/4 oz Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|3/4 ozpre-chilled Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|3/4 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum|3/4 oz Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps
instructions: The taste of this Four Horsemen recipe reminds most of Cinnaburst or Big Red gum, a very potent cinnimon flavor that will curl the hairs in your nose (and the person in the direct line of your exhale).Pour contents into an old-fashioned glass, give a slight stir and serve.
shopping: Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|Bacardi(R) 151 rum|Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps

name: Bayou Self
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|1 1/2 oz butterscotch schnapps|4 oz pineapple juice|1 splash grenadine syrup
instructions: Pour Captain Morgan spiced rum, butterscotch schnapps and pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass 3/4 filled with ice. Top with grenadine, and garnish with a maraschino cherry and a slice of pineapple.
shopping: Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|butterscotch schnapps|pineapple juice|grenadine syrup

name: J. R.'s Dallas Martini
ingredients: 4 oz Belvedere(R) vodka|1 splash Martini & Rossi(R) extra dry vermouth|Reese Extra Large Green olives|aged Roquefort cheese
instructions: Splash the vermouth into chilled 10-oz martini glass, swirl and spill. Half-fill a cocktail shaker with cracked ice, add vodka and shake vigorously. Strain into glass. Garnish with several extra large green olives stuffed with aged Roquefort cheese, one will not be enough.
shopping: Belvedere(R) vodka|Martini & Rossi(R) extra dry vermouth|olives|cheese

name: Juan Blue
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz tequila|2 oz orange juice|1 oz grapefruit juice|1/2 oz lemon juice|1 dash bitters|2 tsp Blue Curacao liqueur
instructions: Pour tequila, orange juice, grapefruit juice, lemon juice and bitters in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Carefully float the curacao on top by pouring over the back of a teaspoon, and serve.
shopping: tequila|orange juice|grapefruit juice|lemon juice|bitters|Blue Curacao liqueur

name: Raspberry Jello Spritzer
ingredients: 3/4 cup vodka|1/4 cup Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|1 cup 7-Up(R) soda|2 cups water|1 package sparkling berry jello
instructions: Mix Jello with 2 cups boiling water. Once disolved set in fridge to cool for 10 minutes. Add 7-up, vodka and Chambord (raspberry liquor) to and stir until blended. On a cookie sheet, line plastic 1 oz cups or dixie cups and pour into containers. Chill until firm and serve.
shopping: vodka|Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|7-Up(R) soda|water|sparkling berry jello

name: Demolitious
ingredients: 1 oz 151 proof rum|2 oz coconut rum|2 oz Alize(R) Red Passion liqueur|1 oz cranberry juice|1 oz pineapple juice
instructions: Fill collins glass with ice. Add AlizA(C) and coconut rum, then fill with equal amounts of cranberry and pineapple juice, leaving space for the 151 rum to float on top. Shake ingredients before adding the 151 rum. Garnish with sliced pineapples and cherries on a toothpick.
shopping: 151 proof rum|coconut rum|Alize(R) Red Passion liqueur|cranberry juice|pineapple juice

name: Raspberry Punch
ingredients: 46 oz pink Grapefruit juice|12 oz Raspberry juice|1 qt raspberry Sherbet|2 L Ginger ale
instructions: Pour pink grapefruit juice and ginger ale into punch bowl. Pour raspberry juice or 12 oz frozen raspberries into punch bowl (if using frozen raspberries, be sure to stir to un-thaw after adding to punch bowl). Add sherbet into punch and stir until majority of it is melted.

name: Jungle Boogie Punch
ingredients: Crushed Brown sugar|Peel of 1 Orange|Water|1 fifth Light rum (Havana Club)|1 fifth Dark rum (Havana Club)|1 L Pineapple juice|1 L Mango juice|1 L Orange juice|Juice of 2-3 Lime|Chunks of Pineapple|Chunks of Mango|Chunks of Orange|Grated Nutmeg
instructions: Make a sugar syrup by boiling brown sugar, water and orange peel for 30 minutes, then allow it to cool. Stir it together with the other ingredients in a large bowl. Garnish with chunks of pineapple, mango and orange, and sprinkle with freshly grated nutmeg before serving.
shopping: Brown sugar|Orange|Water|Light rum|Dark rum|Pineapple juice|Mango juice|Orange juice|Lime|Pineapple|Mango|Orange|Nutmeg

name: Berry Cool
ingredients: 5/6 oz Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|1/6 oz Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|5/6 oz creme de mure|1 splash Ocean Spray(R) cranberry juice|3 red grapes|2 - 3  strawberries|1 slice orange
instructions: Muddle fruit in glass with ice, add alcohol and shake with more ice. Strain into glass filled with crushed ice, top with cranberry juice. To garnish, slice a strawberry in half and make a slice halfway so it sits on the rim, and spear a sliver of orange peel into the top.
shopping: Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|creme de mure|Ocean Spray(R) cranberry juice|grapes|strawberries|orange

name: Hot Devilish Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 1/2 cup hot Water|1/4 cup Sugar|2 sticks Cinnamon|8 whole Cloves|6 oz frozen Lemonade concentrate|6 oz frozen Limeade concentrate|1/2 cup Light rum
instructions: In 2 qt. microproof casserole, combine hot water, sugar, spices, and concentrated juices. Stir, then cook on HI 5-6 minutes or until mixture boils. Heat rum in microproof container on HI for 30 seconds. Ignite and pour over hot beverage. Ladle into punch cups for serving.

name: Danish Gin Fizz
ingredients: 2 oz gin|1/2 oz Heering(R) cherry liqueur|1 tsp Kirschwasser(R) cherry brandy|1/2 ozfresh lime juice|1/2 tsp superfine sugar|2 1/2 oz soda water
instructions: Pour the gin, cherry heering, kirsch, lime juice and sugar into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Gently stir in the soda/sparkling water. Garnish with a maraschino cherry and a slice of lime.
shopping: gin|Heering(R) cherry liqueur|Kirschwasser(R) cherry brandy|lime juice|superfine sugar|soda water

name: Flaming Armageddon
ingredients: 1/2 oz tequila|1/2 oz Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|1/2 oz Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|1/2 oz 151 proof rum|1 can Sparks(R) energy drink
instructions: Pour a can of Sparks energy drink shared between 2 seperate beer mugs. Shake tequila, Jagermeister, and Rumple Minze on ice and strain into 2 seperate shot glasses. Add 151 to the top of each and ignite. Drop shots into the beer glasses with Sparks in and drink. Serves 2.
shopping: tequila|Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|151 proof rum|Sparks(R) energy drink

name: Oxnas Temptation
ingredients: 6 cl Vodka|2 cl Banana liqueur|Nearly fill glass with Sprite|1 splash Orange juice concentrate|A tiny splash Grenadine for colour
instructions: Start by adding the vodka and the banan liqueur. Fill the glass with sprite or similar soft drink. Pour some conc. orange juice. Stir. Add some grenadine for that nice Tequila Sunrise effect, or don't if you think it will be to sweet. Add a slice of orange for decoration.

name: Goombay Smash #3
ingredients: 1 oz Bacardi(R) gold rum|1 oz Bacardi(R) Coco rum|4 oz pineapple juice|1 splash sweet and sour mix
instructions: Pour the Bacardi gold rum and Bacardi Coco rum, along with the pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake untill well chilled. Strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes, and add a splash of sweet and sour mix. Stir lightly and serve.
shopping: Bacardi(R) gold rum|Bacardi(R) Coco rum|pineapple juice|sweet and sour mix

name: Champagne Cornucopia
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|3/4 oz peach schnapps|1 oz Champagne|2 scoops rainbow sherbert|1 oz cranberry juice
instructions: Pour the cranberry juice into a large red wine glass and set aside. Combine sherbet, vodka, and peach schnapps in a cocktail shaker. Shake until smooth. Pour over cranberry juice to product a swirl effect. Layer champagne on top. Garnish with a slice of orange, and serve.

name: Van Nuys (aka Dirty Margarita)
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz tequila|3/4 oz triple sec|3/4 oz sweet and sour mix|3/4 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur
instructions: Invented by H.B. Stone, inspired by the city of Van Nuys, CA... It's a tasty drink; citrus at first, then the sweetness of the Kahlua builds after you swallow.Shake and strain into a thoroughly chilled margarita glass. Optionally, build over ice in an old fashioned glass.
shopping: tequila|triple sec|sweet and sour mix|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur

name: Girlie Martini
ingredients: 1 splash Dry Vermouth|4 oz Vodka|3 oz chilled Champagne|1 dash Maraschino liqueur
instructions: Coat the inside of a chilled cocktail glass with dry vermouth. In a mixing glass filled half way with crushed ice, combine vodka, champagne and maraschino liqueur. Stir and strain into the cocktail glass. Garnish with an olive and a maraschino cherry on a cocktail skewer.

name: Big Dumb Russian
ingredients: Ice cubes|2 oz Vodka (Absolut)|3 parts Sprite|1 splash Pineapple juice|Blue Maui
instructions: Fill the glass with ice. I like to use a standard beer glass. Add about 2 shots of vodka. Then fill the glass about 3/4th of the way with Sprite. Then add just a splash of pineapple juice. Finally, add the Blue Maui until you get a faint (almost skyblue) blue color. Stir.

name: Barber Chair Shot
ingredients: 1 oz Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila|1 oz strawberry margarita mix
instructions: Pour equal amounts of tequila and margarita mix into separate shot glasses. Lay person back in barber shop chair. Lay towl on chest of that person. Someone is to stand behind that person and pour the shots in to that persons mouth. They close and swish to blend and drink.
shopping: Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila|strawberry margarita mix

name: Vegas Lemon Drop Martini
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Absolut(R) Citron vodka|1 tsp sugar|1/4  lemon
instructions: Slice the 1/4 lemon into two seperate wedges. Place in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Pour the Absolut Citron into the shaker, and add one teaspoon of sugar. Shake vigorously. Strain into a sugar-rimmed cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist, and serve.

name: Punch #2
ingredients: 1 1/4 cup Water|1 1/2 cup ice Water|1 cup chilled Lemon juice|1/2 cup Strawberries|1 pint Ginger ale|1 1/2 cup Sugar|2 1/2 cups chilled Orange juice|1 cup Pineapple juice|Lemon slices|Orange slices
instructions: Stir the 1 1/4 cups water and sugar over medium heat until sugar is dissolved.Bring to boil and boil for 5 mins. Cool pour into screw top jar and chill over night . Just before serving pour into a punch bowl all except ginger ale Now pour ginger ale now put in the fruit.

name: Adam Bomb
ingredients: 1 part Rum (Ron Bacardi)|1 part Vodka (Absolut)|1 part Tequila (Jose Cuervo)|1/2 part Triple sec|Fruit|1/2 glass Ice|Salt or sugar|1-3 pint Fruit juice
instructions: Add ice to blender (or to glass if prefer on the rocks) then fruit, and fruite juice depending on personal prefference then add the Rum, Vodka, Tequila, and triple sec. blend till smooth, rim glass with sugar or salt and pour mixture in. garnish with lemon or lime slice.

name: Caribbean Mist
ingredients: 1 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1 oz Midori(R) melon liqueur|1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|2 oz pineapple juice|2 oz sweet and sour mix|1 splash 7-Up(R) soda
instructions: Pour the Malibu rum, Midori melon liqueur, blue curacao and pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass. Top with 7-up, and stir briefly. Garnish with a maraschino cherry and a pineapple flag, and serve.
shopping: Malibu(R) coconut rum|Midori(R) melon liqueur|Blue Curacao liqueur|pineapple juice|sweet and sour mix|7-Up(R) soda

name: Champagne Punch #2
ingredients: 2 cups Sugar|375 ml Brandy|6 bottles Champagne|6 Orange, sliced|6 Lemon, sliced|6 Lime, sliced|1 Pineapple, chunks|1/2 bag crushed Ice|Strawberries
instructions: Mix sugar, brandy and 5 bottles champagne in a punch bowl. Then stir in orange, lemon and lime sliced thin into rounds, pineapple chunks and ice. Stir until well mixed. To complete, garnish with strawberries and pour a final bottle of champagne theatrically over the top.

name: Mojito Diablo
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz white tequila|1/2 oz creme de cassis|2  lime|12 fresh mint|3 - 6 oz 7-Up(R) soda|1 tbsp brown sugar
instructions: Muddle sugar, mint and squeezed lime wedges in mixing tin until mixture smells like spearmint gum. Fill with ice, add tequila and cassis, shake until the tin is icey to the touch. Pour into a collins glass, top with 7-up and garnish with a sugarcane stick and fresh mint.
shopping: white tequila|creme de cassis|lime|mint|7-Up(R) soda|brown sugar

name: Murder in the Forest
ingredients: 1 measure Pisang Ambon|1 measure Pina Colada|1 measure Vodka|2 measures Orange juice|1 dash Grenadine
instructions: Use a shaker: put in cracked ice and orange juice, then put in Vodka, Pisang Ambon and Pina Colada and give it all a good shake. Poor in glass ( if you like you can put in a cube of ice or two ). Poor a dash of grenadine in ( slowly ). Serve with cherry and straw. Enjoy!

name: German Chocolate
ingredients: 1 oz Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|1 oz100 proof Absolut(R) vodka|sugar|1 slice lemon
instructions: Pour shot of smirnoff and frangelico into short glass. Heavily coat the lemon slice.^^^^Bite the lemon, don't swallow the juice. Leave the sugar on your lips, and take the shot. Lick the sugar off your lips.^^^^Taste like german chocolate, w/out any chocolate in the mix.

name: My Malibu Delight
ingredients: 3 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|3 - 6 oz Sprite(R) soda|2 - 3  cherries|1 - 2 twists lemons
instructions: Get a cold beer mug and a straw. Add 1 part (about 3 shots worth) of Malibu Rum, and add 1 to 2 parts (depending how strong you want it) of Sprite or 7-up. Add a few cherries or a lemon twist or two, -or- add all the fruit. Put in the straw, add ice to chill, and enjoy!!

name: Cappy's Grog
ingredients: 1/2 oz Galliano(R) herbal liqueur|1/2 oz spiced rum|water|1 twist limes
instructions: Wash some ice.  Put into glass.  Dump the booze in o'er the ice.  Get your water in there right after that.  Squeeze that bit o lime into it, stir, toss the rind afterward.  Don't try to be fancy.  Just hand it to your miss or your mate and say AARrr there ya be!  Enjoy!

name: Crooked Golf Cart
ingredients: 5 parts Cranberry juice|1 part Amaretto|1 splash Rum|2 slices Lime
instructions: Fill glass to top with ice. Pour Cranberry juice to about the halfway point. Then, pour in amaretto and continue to fill glass to top with cranberry juice. Throw a splash of rum in at the top and stir lightly. Make sure and drink over the lime, it adds an awesome flavor!

name: Gin Cup
ingredients: 3 oz gin|1 tsp sugar syrup|3/4 - 1 oz lemon juice|3  mint|ice
instructions: Place the mint sprigs and sugar syrup in the bottom of an old-fashioned glass. Stir about to bruise the mint slightly. Fill the glass with chopped / shaved ice. Add the lemon juice and gin and stir until a frost begins to form. Decorate with extra mint sprigs, and serve.

name: Root Beer Barrel
ingredients: 1 shot Root beer schnapps|Beer
instructions: Fill shot glass with schnapps. Fill tumbler about 3/4 full of beer. Place filled shot glass upright in filled tumbler. Beer should be just short of covering top of shot glass. Just before drinking, cover entire drink with hand and slam on table or bar. Drink all at once.

instructions: Popular in Grand Rapids, MI area. This particular Bazooka recipe was invented by Brian Hobbs. Pour about 5-6 oz from a small can of Red Bull into a large cocktail glass. Gently add one ounce of sambuca, contained in a shot glass, into the cocktail glass of Red Bull.
shopping: Romana(R) white sambuca|Red Bull(R) energy drink

name: Bourbon a la Creme
ingredients: 2 oz bourbon whiskey|1 oz brown creme de cacao|1  vanilla
instructions: Pour the bourbon whiskey and brown creme de cacao over the vanilla bean in a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into a glass without ice, and chill in the refrigerator for at least one hour. Pour into a white wine glass, stir well, and serve.

name: Jojo and Alex Special
ingredients: 1 1/3 oz amaretto almond liqueur|2/3 oz vodka|1/3 oz rum|2 2/3 oz orange juice|1 1/3 oz apple juice|1 1/3 oz grenadine syrup|2/3 oz lemon juice
instructions: Pour all ingredients (except grenadine) into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass filled with crushed ice. Gently pour grenadine across the top. Garnish with a slice of orange and a maraschino cherry, and serve.
shopping: amaretto almond liqueur|vodka|rum|orange juice|apple juice|grenadine syrup|lemon juice

name: Cancun Current
ingredients: 1 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum|1 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1/2 oz pineapple juice|1 splash Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur
instructions: Pour the 151, Mailbu, and pineapple juice into a mixer full of ice, shake, and strain into a rocks glass. Tilt the rocks glass and pour the Chambord onto the glass. The Chambord will sink to the bottom giving you a golden top layer and a purple bottom layer. Serve.
shopping: Bacardi(R) 151 rum|Malibu(R) coconut rum|pineapple juice|Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur

name: Van Gogh
ingredients: 1 tsp creme de cassis|1 tsp absinthe herbal liqueur|1/4 tsp blackberry brandy|4 - 6 oz Brut(R) Champagne
instructions: Absinthe is not legal in the US because it contains wormwood; however, you are able to purchase the US version without this ingredient.In a Champagne flute combine Cassis, Absinthe and Black Berry Brandy. Top off to the top with Champagne. Stir very lightly. Enjoy!
shopping: creme de cassis|absinthe herbal liqueur|blackberry brandy|Brut(R) Champagne

name: Christopher Walken
ingredients: 1 oz light rum|1 oz melon liqueur|1/2 oz lemon juice|1/2 oz lime juice|1 tsp sugar|10 oz 7-Up(R) soda
instructions: This politely named concoction was invented on a cold winter's night in Rockford, MI by Shane and Dave.Stir rum, melon liqueur, and juices together in a collins glass. Fill with 7-Up and stir in sugar to make a nice fizz. Top with a mini-umbrella for festive flair!
shopping: light rum|melon liqueur|lemon juice|lime juice|sugar|7-Up(R) soda

name: Carrie's Midori Sour
ingredients: 1 oz Absolut(R) vodka|2 oz Midori(R) melon liqueur|2 oz sweet and sour mix|1 1/2 oz Sprite(R) soda
instructions: Pour the Absolut vodka, Midori melon liqueur and sour mix into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Top with Sprite, and stir lightly. Garnish with a lemon or lime wedge, and serve.
shopping: Absolut(R) vodka|Midori(R) melon liqueur|sweet and sour mix|Sprite(R) soda

name: Bookmaker's Luck
ingredients: 1 oz Absolut(R) vodka|1 oz white rum|1/2 oz creme de bananes|orange juice|lime juice|ginger ale
instructions: Pour the vodka, rum, lime juice (to taste) and orange juice (to taste) into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass 1/3 filled with ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, add creme de bananes on top, stir once and serve.
shopping: Absolut(R) vodka|white rum|creme de bananes|orange juice|lime juice|ginger ale

name: JMO Sling
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz gin|1 1/2 oz sloe gin|1 splash sweet and sour mix|4 - 5 oz club soda
instructions: This variation on the Singapore Sling is popular in Ohio and central Pennsylvania.Combine the gin, sloe gin and sour mix in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well and strain into a collins glass filled with ice cubes. Add the club soda, and serve.
shopping: gin|sloe gin|sweet and sour mix|club soda

name: Manhattan for Rome
ingredients: 1 oz Maker's Mark(R) bourbon whiskey|1 oz Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur
instructions: Build the Maker's Mark Bourbon whiskey and Frangelico hazelnut liqueur in an old-fashioned glass over ice and garnish with a maraschino cherry. Alternatively, muddle the cherry with ice before adding the Maker's Mark Bourbon whiskey and Frangelico hazelnut liqueur.
shopping: Maker's Mark(R) bourbon whiskey|Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur

name: La Charentaise
ingredients: 1 oz Ricard(R) pastis|1 oz orgeat syrup|2 - 3 ozice cold, full fat milk
instructions: Note: The french like their anis diluted in water, nothing else. It takes a trained palate to savour this and may seem quite rough to people, not accustomed to this drink. The orgeat (almond syup) sweetens it nicely and the milk mellows it.^^^^Annette von Flottwell
shopping: the great-great-great granddaughter of the Prussian Minister of the Exterior under Bismarck

name: Frank Davis Punch
ingredients: 1 liter gold tequila|1.5 liters(2 bottles) chilled Champagne|3 liters(4 bottles) chilled Sauternes white wine|1 cup lemon juice|1/2 cup superfine sugar|1 large honeydew melon
instructions: Stir the lemon juice and sugar together in a large punch bowl until the sugar is dissolved. Add the tequila, champagne and sauternes, and stir well. Add one large block of ice. Garnish with melon balls, cut out from a honeydew melon. Makes 36 (6-ounce) punch cups.
shopping: gold tequila|Champagne|Sauternes white wine|lemon juice|superfine sugar|honeydew melon

name: 4 Godfathers
ingredients: 1 oz Jack Daniel's(R) Tennessee whiskey|1 oz Johnnie Walker(R) Scotch whisky|1 oz Jim Beam(R) bourbon whiskey|1 oz Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila
instructions: 4 Godfathers originated at a private 21st birthday party in the Hudson Valley during the Summer of 1993.Pour the whiskeys and tequila into a whiskey sour glass, stir gently, and serve. Alternatively, pour the whiskeys and tequila over 2 ice cubes, stir, and serve.
shopping: Jack Daniel's(R) Tennessee whiskey|Johnnie Walker(R) Scotch whisky|Jim Beam(R) bourbon whiskey|Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila

name: Miami Sunset
ingredients: 2 oz Windsor(R) Canadian whisky|1 oz Sauza(R) blanco tequila|1 oz DeKuyper(R) triple sec|4 oz orange juice|1 splash grenadine syrup
instructions: A recipe with quite a bit of bite, found in a 1975 issue of Playboy magazine. Miami Sunset tastes like a Tequila Sunrise with more kick.Pour ingredients together on the rocks in an old-fashioned glass. Mix with a stirring stick, and garnish with a slice of orange.
shopping: Windsor(R) Canadian whisky|Sauza(R) blanco tequila|DeKuyper(R) triple sec|orange juice|grenadine syrup

name: Grandma's Swingin' Eggnog
ingredients: 6 Egg yolk|1/2 cup white, granulated Sugar|2 cups Milk|2 cups Light rum|2 cups Whipping cream|Nutmeg
instructions: Beat yolks until light. Add sugar and mix well. Add milk and rum. Mix well, then chill for at least 3 hours. One hour before serving, whip cream and stir into chilled mixture. Return to refrigerator for an hour. Serve in punch cups and dust with nutmeg. Serves 20.

name: Microwave Hot Cocoa
ingredients: 5 tblsp Sugar|3 tblsp Cocoa powder|1 dash Salt|3 tblsp hot Water|2 cups Milk|1/4 tsp Vanilla extract
instructions: Combine sugar, cocoa, salt and hot water in 1-quart micro-proof measuring cup (or coffee mug). Microwave at HIGH (100%) for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until boiling. Add milk, sitr and microwave an additonal 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until hot. Stir in vanilla, blend well.

name: Amaretto Jones
ingredients: 3 ozJones lemon-lime soda|3 oz Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur|3/4-3/2 oz Barenjager(R) honey liqueur
instructions: The Jones Lemon Lime is important: it's not as harshly sour as sour mixes, but not terribly sweet like other lemon lime sodas. Good luck getting a hold of it though. Got the idea when I tried some of this at Qwest Field and thought this would make a good sour mix.

name: Super Smoothy
ingredients: 2 Banana|2 cups Strawberries|2 large chunks Pineapple|4 cups Ice|2 shots Spiced rum (optional)
instructions: Chunk up the two bananas and put them in the bottom of a blender. Place the two large wedges of pineapple, strawberries and ice on top. Add rum if desired. Puree until smooth (a little water or fruit juice might be required). Pour into glass and serve immediately.

name: Red K Martini
ingredients: 1 part vodka|2 parts Martini & Rossi(R) sweet vermouth|1 part dry gin|4 partsred Muscatel wine
instructions: Quite a good finish to a meal of venison or game foul. A nice herbal taste, but sweet... created by Johan van Dijken, South Africa.Shake over ice until well chilled. Strain into a large Martini glass (cocktail glass). Garnish with a red cherry or thin orange peel.
shopping: vodka|Martini & Rossi(R) sweet vermouth|dry gin|Muscatel wine

name: Canadian Breeze
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Canadian whisky|1 tsp pineapple juice|1 tbsp lemon juice|1/2 tsp maraschino liqueur
instructions: Pour the whisky, pineapple juice, lemon juice and maraschino liqueur into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into an old-fashioned glass 1/4 filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a maraschino cherry, and serve.

name: Hot Mess
ingredients: 1/2 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum|1/4 oz caramel syrup|1/4 oz Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps
instructions: Carefully layer ingredients into a shot glass in this order: Goldschlager bottom, Bacardi 151 middle, Caramel top.^^^^For the Caramel, heat in a microwave to the point where its almost liquid. And add to the shot. Light the shot on fire, blow out flames and serve.

name: D.P.R.
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Vodka|1 1/2 oz Triple sec|Add Cranberry juice|Top off 1 splash Club soda
instructions: Fill collins or tall glass with ice. Add 1 ounce of vodka and .5 ounces of triple sec. Fill with cranberry juice leaving about an inch of space for a splash of club soda. Garnish with a slice of lime on the rim of the glass and place one thin straw into the glass.

name: Velvet Revolver
ingredients: 1 oz Aftershock(R) Hot & Cool cinnamon schnapps|1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream
instructions: Preferably poured into a 'twister' shot glass(available from any cheapo booze outlet!), pour the red Aftershock into one side, and the Baileys into the other. Then down in one go,feeling the warmth of the red aftershock and also the cooling flavour of the Baileys.
shopping: Aftershock(R) Hot & Cool cinnamon schnapps|Bailey's(R) Irish cream

name: Sexy Lemon Slam
ingredients: 3/4 oz vodka|1/4 oz triple sec|1/4 oz lemon juice|1/4 tsp sugar
instructions: Place a small sugar coated lemon wheel (approx.1/4 in.thick) into the bottom of an old-fashioned glass. Pour above listed ingredients into a stainless steel shaker with ice, shake until completely cold, and pour into the prepared old-fashioned glass.^^Sip or slam.

name: Chocolate Covered Cherry Jello...
ingredients: 1 cup creme de cacao|4 ozpackage cherry jell-o|1 cuphot water
instructions: This recipe takes two very popular recipes, Chocolate Covered Cherries and Jello Shots, and combines them to make a great dessert shot.Heat water to boiling point. Dissolve jello in the water, add creme de cacao and chill in plastic shot glasses. Serve when ready.

name: Christmas Delight
ingredients: 5 oz vanilla|2 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream
instructions: This is an experiment I tried last Christmas and everyone loved it. I'm not sure if anyone else has invented it before. I haven't seen it.^^^^I love Bailey's and I love Vanilla Eggnog and decided to mix the two.Pour ingredients over a small amount of ice and stir.

name: Chronic Ice Tea
ingredients: 1/2 oz Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|1/2 oz melon liqueur|1/2 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1 oz Smirnoff(R) Raspberry Twist vodka|3 oz 7-Up(R) soda|2 splashes sweet and sour mix
instructions: Fill the glass with ice and start with a shot of raspberry vodka. Next add half shots of Malibu, melon, and blue curacao. Add some sweet and sour mix, nearly fill the glass with 7-up, and finally, float a 1/2 oz of spiced rum. Garnish with a flag (or 2 cherries!)
shopping: Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|Blue Curacao liqueur|melon liqueur|Malibu(R) coconut rum|Smirnoff(R) Raspberry Twist vodka|7-Up(R) soda|sweet and sour mix

name: Claifornia Sour
ingredients: 1 oz amaretto almond liqueur|1 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1 oz sweet and sour mix|1 splash Sprite(R) soda|1  cherry|1  lemon
instructions: My favorite drink is an amaretto sour and I have found that malibu goes down very smooth.  I am a native of Long Beach California, so what better name than California Sour!!^^^^Katherine HarkleyMix as directed use a 1/2 cup of ice, garnish with a lemon and cherry
shopping: amaretto almond liqueur|Malibu(R) coconut rum|sweet and sour mix|Sprite(R) soda|cherry|lemon

name: Cool Breeze Fru-Fru
ingredients: 2 oz Stolichnaya(R) vodka|3 oz Perrier(R) lemon soda water|4 oz tangerine juice|3 oz cranberry juice|1 ozfresh lemon juice
instructions: Cool Breeze Fru-Fru is a variation of the Cool Breeze, a great vodka cocktail.Pour the Stolichnaya (Stoli) vodka, Lemon Perrier, tangerine juice and cranberry juice into a highball glass over 5 ice cubes. Add the juice extracted from half a lemon. Stir and serve.
shopping: Stolichnaya(R) vodka|Perrier(R) lemon soda water|tangerine juice|cranberry juice|lemon juice

name: Peach on the Beach
ingredients: 1 oz Absolut(R) Apeach vodka|1 oz DeKuyper(R) Peachtree schnapps|1 oz pineapple juice|3 oz cranberry juice
instructions: Peach on the Beach was created at Grindstone Brewery in Columbia MO (home of the Tigers) on a fine Sunday morning by bartender Jake Maulin.Fill a highball glass with ice, and add the vodka, schnapps, and pineapple juice. Fill with cranberry juice. Stir and serve.
shopping: Absolut(R) Apeach vodka|DeKuyper(R) Peachtree schnapps|pineapple juice|cranberry juice

name: Presidential Margarita
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz El Presidente Brandy|1 1/2 oz Cointreau|1 1/2 oz Tequila (Hornitos)|Juice of 1 Lime
instructions: Pour each ingredent into a large glass. Add ice and let sit while preparing drinking glass. Rim glass with lime and salt. Fill glass with ice and add a lime slice (for looks). Carefully pour contents of large glass into salted glass (careful not to disturb salt).

name: Shwin-tastic
ingredients: 1 cup Canada Dry(R) ginger ale|1 1/2 - 2 shots E&J(R) brandy|3 - 4 oz Welch's(R) grape juice
instructions: 1.) Pour ginger ale into cup(do not add ice yet).^^2.) Add 1 and 1/2 to 2 shots of Brandy.^^3.) Stir moderatly with a stirring rod.^^4.) Add 3- 4 ounces of Grape Juice and stir same as above.^^5.) Add ice. Final color should look a bit darker than a regular beer.
shopping: Canada Dry(R) ginger ale|E&J(R) brandy|Welch's(R) grape juice

name: Deep Blue Something
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|1 oz peach schnapps|1 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|8 ozcan Red Bull(R) energy drink
instructions: Mix the vodka, peach schnapps and Red Bull together in a collins glass. Add a small amount of curacao until the mixture is a deep green. Add some ice, and pour the remainder of the curacao down the side of the glass to leave a blue layer at the base of the glass.
shopping: vodka|peach schnapps|Blue Curacao liqueur|Red Bull(R) energy drink

name: L.A. Riot
ingredients: 1 part Kahlua|1 part Bailey's irish cream|2-3 drops Green Chartreuse|1 pinch Cinnamon
instructions: Fill half a shot glass with Kahlua, and pour on Baileys in a separate layer, nearly to the top of the glass. Add a small amount of green chartreuse to float on the top. Light the drink on fire and sprinkle over cinnamon. Drink through a straw while still on fire.

name: Clam Eye
ingredients: 7 oz Clamato juice (preferably Motts)|1 bottle Beer (preferably canadian)
instructions: Shake Clamato (keep at room temperature). Pour Clamato into Pilsner glass or oversized beer mug. Pour beer generously down the inside of the glass until full. Be careful of foaming head. Add celery salt, tobasco sauce, and/or worchestershire sauce for flavouring.

name: Lemouroudji
ingredients: 2 pieces Ginger|1 gal Water|1 lb Lemon|1 cup Sugar|ground Cayenne pepper
instructions: Juice the lemons. Peel and grate the ginger. Place the grated ginger and a liberal dash of the cayenne pepper into a piece of cheesecloth, and tie it into a knot. Let soak in the water. After 15 minutes or so, add the sugar, and the lemon juice. Chill, and serve.

name: Coconut Shell
ingredients: 3 oz white rum|1 1/2 oz creme de bananes|2 large coconuts|milk
instructions: Drain the coconuts and save the liquid. Scoop out the flesh and place in a blender. Add white rum, creme de bananes and milk. Add 3-4 oz. of crushed ice and blend until smooth. Pour back into the coconut shells. Add more milk (if needed) until a nice consistancy.

name: Fresh Melon Martini
ingredients: 2 oz Skyy(R) melon vodka|1  honeydew melon|1  cantaloupe melon
instructions: Cut up both melons and add to blender. Blend well and strain. Add Skyy melon vodka to a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Add about 2-4 oz of the blended melon juice. Shake well, and strain into a cocktail glass. Add a melon ball for garnish, and serve.

name: Unknown Warrior
ingredients: 1 piece Sugar|3 cl Cointreau|3 cl Vodka
instructions: Blend vodka and cointreau in a shotglass. Set the drink on fire with a match. Put the piece of sugar on a fork and hold it over the flame from the drink and let it melt down into the glass. When the sugar has melted,use the palm of your hand to put out the flame.

name: Bongo Cola
ingredients: 2 oz gold rum|1 oz coffee liqueur|1 dash Kirschwasser(R) cherry brandy|2 oz pineapple juice|1 dashfresh lemon juice|3 oz cola
instructions: Pour gold rum, coffee liqueur, kirsch, pineapple juice and lemon juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into a collins glass filled with ice cubes. Fill with cola, and stir gently. Garnish with a maraschino cherry, and serve.
shopping: gold rum|coffee liqueur|Kirschwasser(R) cherry brandy|pineapple juice|lemon juice|cola

name: Mr. Stumpfy
ingredients: 1 oz lime gin|1 splash grenadine syrup|1 dash lime juice|1 dash lemon juice|6 oz Vault(R) energy drink
instructions: Start with a cup, pour in one shot of the gin then a splash of grenadine to taste (you will figure this out after you drink 2 or 3) then add a dash of lime juice and a dash of lemon juice. Fill up the rest of the cup (about 6 oz) with vault energy soda and stir.
shopping: lime gin|grenadine syrup|lime juice|lemon juice|Vault(R) energy drink

name: Absolut Dream
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Absolut(R) Mandrin vodka|1 oz sweet and sour mix|1/2 oz Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur
instructions: Pour Absolut Mandrin into a cocktail/martini shaker. Add sweet and sour mix, and Chambord raspberry liqueur. Rim a cocktail glass with sugar. Shake and strain the contents of the cocktail shaker into the cocktail glass. Garnish with a twist of orange, and serve.
shopping: Absolut(R) Mandrin vodka|sweet and sour mix|Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur

name: The Jory Krieger
ingredients: 1 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|1/2 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|1 splash vanilla vodka
instructions: Mix all ingredients and serve on the rocks.^^^^Can also be served as a chilled shooter:^^Use 1/2 oz. Southern Comfort and 1/4 oz. Kahlua and a splash of Vanilla vodka (Shake and strain into a shooter).^^^^For a different taste substitue the Kahlua for Tia Maria.
shopping: Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|vanilla vodka

name: Barn Burner
ingredients: 1/3 oz Mohawk(R) Extra Sharp ginger brandy|1/3 oz cinnamon schnapps|1/3 oz Tabasco(R) sauce
instructions: Word on the street is that Mohawk's Ginger Brandy has ceased production, so your Barn Burner may have to be put out after all. Nonetheless, for those that still have a few cases locked up, here's a nice recipe.Mix ingredients together in a shot glass, and serve.
shopping: Mohawk(R) Extra Sharp ginger brandy|cinnamon schnapps|Tabasco(R) sauce

name: Cayman Sunset
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Light rum|1/2 oz Pina colada mix|Fill with Pineapple juice|1/2 oz Grenadine
instructions: Fill a highball glass half way with crushed ice. Add light rum and pina colada mix, then fill with pineapple juice. Stir. Add grenadine in the middle of the drink and let it settle on the bottom. Do not stir the grenadine. Garnish with an orange wedge and serve.

name: Marbella Sunset
ingredients: 1/4 oz light rum|1/4 oz strawberry liqueur|1 oz pineapple juice|1 oz orange juice
instructions: Add the rum, pineapple juice and orange juice to a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice and shake well. Slowly strain into a cocktail glass and add the strawberry liqueur (it will sink to the bottom giving pink and orange hues reminiscent of a Marbella sunset!).

name: Loud-Mouth
ingredients: 2 parts Southern Comfort 100 Prf.|1 part Peach schnapps
instructions: This is a Winter drink which can only be consumed outdoors preferbly in an alpine environment. It is should be consumed in small swigs from a French Canteen type of devide and only after a epic day of skiing...Why yes it's strong but you'll be the better for it.

name: Ginein's Raspberry Surprise
ingredients: 1 oz raspberry liqueur|1 oz peach schnapps|1 oz triple sec|1 oz cranberry liqueur|1 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1 oz vodka|1 cup ice|1  strawberry|1 slice orange
instructions: Combine the vodka, rum, raspberry liqueur, triple sec, peach schnapps, and cranberry liqueur in a cocktail shaker filled with ice.  Shake well for about 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into a highball glass half-filled with ice. Garnish with a strawberry and orange slice.
shopping: raspberry liqueur|peach schnapps|triple sec|cranberry liqueur|Malibu(R) coconut rum|vodka|ice|strawberry|orange

name: Cloud 99
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz 99 Bananas(R) banana schnapps|1/2 oz peach schnapps|1/2 oz strawberry schnapps|1 dash orange juice|1 drop grenadine syrup
instructions: Mix the banana, peach, and strawberry schnapps. Shake and strain into a double shot glass. Add a drop of grenadine and let it sink to the bottom. Add a splash of orange juice and let it swirl. If done properly, it will look like a cloudy sunset, hence the name.
shopping: 99 Bananas(R) banana schnapps|peach schnapps|strawberry schnapps|orange juice|grenadine syrup

name: Skip and Go Naked #3
ingredients: 2 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|1 oz Jack Daniel's(R) Tennessee whiskey|1 can light beer|1 oz grenadine syrup|6 oz lemonade
instructions: Made by the bartenders at Tahoe Joes in San Luis Obispo, drink three and you'll be able to get any girl in the room.Use a tall beer mug, 22oz or something like that. Pour the shots in first, add beer then grenadine, then top off with limonade, stir if you want.
shopping: Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|Jack Daniel's(R) Tennessee whiskey|light beer|grenadine syrup|lemonade

name: Candy Corn Martini
ingredients: 3/4 oz Absolut(R) vanilla vodka|1/2 oz creme de cacao|1/2 oz butterscotch schnapps|2 oz orange juice|1 tbspdark cocoa powder
instructions: First, ring 6 oz Martini glass with orange juice then with Cocoa powder. Pour 1/2 cup of ice into shaker, then spirits, and Orange Juice. Shake vigorously and pour into glass. Garnish with Orange Peel Twist and 3-4 pcs of Candy Corn skewered on a plastic sword.
shopping: Absolut(R) vanilla vodka|creme de cacao|butterscotch schnapps|orange juice|cocoa powder

name: Mud Island Tea
ingredients: 2 gallons Milo's(R) sweet tea|1 fifth spiced rum|1 fifth triple sec|6 bottles Mike's(R) hard lemonade
instructions: Need the 2 gallons of tea and 1 extra gallon jug. Pour 1/3 from each of the 2 gallons of tea into empty gallon jug. Add 2 bottles of mike's into each gallon. Add 1/3 of each fifth rum/triple sec into each gallon. Garnish with lemon slices. Serve over ice cubes.
shopping: Milo's(R) sweet tea|spiced rum|triple sec|Mike's(R) hard lemonade

name: The Rhianna
ingredients: 25 ml Green Chartreuse(R)|15 ml Parfait Amour(R) orange liqueur|35 ml paraiso|3  lime|2 kaffir mint
instructions: Muddle lime and mint, with green chartreuse, parfait amour and paraiso. Add a splash of lemonade (or sweet and sour mix for a more bitter taste), shake and double strain into a martini glass.^^^^Skewered lychee, with caramelized brown sugar coating for garnish.

name: Muskmelon
ingredients: 1 1/4 oz dark rum|1/4 cup cantaloupe melon|1/2 oz lime juice|1/2 oz orange juice|1/2 tsp sugar
instructions: Combine the dark rum, pieces of cantaloupe melon, lime juice, orange juice and sugar with 1/3 cup of crushed ice in a blender. Blend well until smooth. Pour into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a piece of cantaloupe, and serve.

name: Glogg in the Microwave
ingredients: 1 bottle Red wine|3 sticks Cinnamon bark|8 Cloves|1/2 dl Sugar|Juice of 1/2 Lemon
instructions: Mix all ingredients, except for the lemonslices, in a coffee mug. Heat it (using a lid) on full power for 5-6 minutes or, if you are using a temperature meter, 75'C. Stir, until the sugar is dissolved. Serve in a small cup, with a slice of lemon for decoration.

name: Jager Bomb
ingredients: 1/2 can Red Bull(R) energy drink|1 - 2 oz Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur
instructions: The Jager Bomb is originally a mixture of Red Bull and Jagermeister, both being popular products, although it's increasingly common for other energy drinks to be substituted for the RB. The caffeine-alcohol combination creates a unique high or at the very least
shopping: a counteract to the depressant of alcohol - making you more aware

name: Coffee and Dreams
ingredients: 1 cup coffee|1 shot Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1/2 - 1 oz whipped cream
instructions: Coffee and Dreams is inspired by a Colombian bar with the same name.... this is a coffee drinker's drink.Pour one cup of hot coffee and add Bailey's Irsh Cream and top with whipped cream. Add milk if desired, but the Bailey's Irish cream might be enough, enjoy.

name: Speedy Gonzalez Boiler Popper
ingredients: 2 shots silver tequila|12 ozMexican beer|12 oz energy soda|2  lime
instructions: Invented by: Karim Gonzalez -proffesional bartender from Los Angeles CA. The name is self explainatory..... Let's just say that after you are done with these 28 oz of loco you'll be set for at least couple of hours.Have the 2 separate 2oz shots of tequila ready
shopping: take an empty pint glass and quickly pour beer and energy drink at the same time until it starts to foam up

name: Angel Hair
ingredients: 3/4 oz gold rum|1/4 oz peach schnapps
instructions: Make sure that both ingredients have been in the freezer for several hours and are nice and cold. In the glass, add about 3/4 rum, and fill the remaining 1/4 with peach schnapps. Hold shot glass to light, and small tendrils, almost like hair can be seen. Shoot.

name: Jared's Concoction
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|1 oz rum|1 oz gin|1 oz whiskey|2 oz tequila|1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|2 oz Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|1 oz vermouth|1 1/2 oz Tabasco(R) sauce
instructions: This drink was created by Jared Peterson to proove his buddy couldn't handle anything he was given. It worked. Jared's Concontion is now a popular recipe at Michigan Tech.Shake all ingredients well in a cocktail shaker. Pour into a 12 oz beer pilsner and chug.
shopping: vodka|rum|gin|whiskey|tequila|Bailey's(R) Irish cream|Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|vermouth|Tabasco(R) sauce

name: Vista Way Margarita
ingredients: 1 splash Drambuie(R) Scotch whisky|1 1/2 ozfresh lime juice|1 1/2 oz Sauza(R) Tres Generaciones reposado tequila|1 1/2 oz Gaetano(R) triple sec|1 squeeze lime
instructions: Courtesy of Raul Blanhir of El Callejon Restaurant, Vista, CA.Drambuie splash first, burn the liquor with fresh lime. Add ice, then add Tres generaciones tequila, Gaetano triple sec and stir.^^^^Serve in a margarita 10 oz. glass with salt on the rim and serve.
shopping: Drambuie(R) Scotch whisky|lime juice|Sauza(R) Tres Generaciones reposado tequila|Gaetano(R) triple sec|lime

name: Blue Velvet
ingredients: 1 oz black raspberry liqueur|1 oz melon liqueur|4 oz vanilla ice cream|1 dash Blue Curacao liqueur|1/2 oz whipped cream
instructions: Combine the black raspberry liqueur, melon liqueur and vanilla ice cream in a blender. Add a cup of crushed ice and blend until smooth. Pour into a parfait glass, and top with whipped cream. Add blue curacao on top, garnish with a maraschino cherry, and serve.
shopping: black raspberry liqueur|melon liqueur|vanilla ice cream|Blue Curacao liqueur|whipped cream

name: Fuzzy Charlie
ingredients: 1 1/4 oz dark rum|1/2 oz creme de bananes|1/2 oz coconut cream|2 oz pineapple juice|2 - 3 oz ginger ale
instructions: Pour the dark rum, creme de bananes, coconut cream and pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes, and top with ginger ale. Garnish with a pineapple spear, and serve.
shopping: dark rum|creme de bananes|coconut cream|pineapple juice|ginger ale

name: Complete Mess
ingredients: Cacique Yonique(R) yogurt|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|Smirnoff(R) Ice|Coca-Cola(R)
instructions: Place an equal amount of Smirnoff Ice into three seperate half-pint glasses (from a full bottle of Smirnoff Ice). Add both half a shot of cointreau and half a shot of cassique to each. Mix the ingredients.^^^^Fill with coke and add ice. Stir well.^^^^Serves 3.
shopping: Cacique Yonique(R) yogurt|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|Smirnoff(R) Ice|Coca-Cola(R)

name: Irish Mint
ingredients: 3 parts Bailey's irish cream|1 part Green Creme de Menthe|6 parts Milk
instructions: Pour the milk first and then the Irish Cream - the parts are only guesses, I tend to go by color. You want a creamy beige that has only a slight hint of alcohol. Add just enough Creme de Menthe so as to turn the drink slightly green. Stir it up and serve cold.
shopping: Bailey's irish cream|Green Creme de Menthe|Milk

name: Doctor Pepper
ingredients: draft beer|1/4 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum|3/4 oz amaretto almond liqueur
instructions: Place 1/2 of Draft in a mug.^^Place 3/4 oz. Amaretto into a shot glass.^^Float/Layer 1/4 oz. Bacardi 151 on top of the Amaretto. ^^^^Light the Bacardi as to set it on fire.^^^^Quickly drop the shot glass with Amaretto and Bacardi into the Draft Beer and shoot.

name: Flaming Rasta
ingredients: 1 part Amaretto|1 part Grenadine|1 part Bacardi 151 proof rum
instructions: If you can use a tall shot glass you will also need a straw and a lighter. When the drink is poured make sure your 151 is on top. then get your starw like it so it is wet light the drink (run the lighter over top or a match). Put your starw in a drink it fast.

name: The Irish Roundhouse Kick
ingredients: 1 part whiskey|3 parts vodka|4 partsfresh orange juice
instructions: NOTE: This recipie is for multiple shots.^^Add the vodka, whiskey and orange juice to a blender, in that order. Blend on high for 15 seconds. Allow to settle slightly, then pour into shots.^^^^For extra citrus kick, add a few drops of lemon juice to each shot.

name: Eye Opening Bloody Mary
ingredients: 750 ml vodka|46 ozcan V8(R) vegetable juice|3 tbspwhite horseradish|3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce|3 tbspfresh lime juice|1 tbsp Tabasco(R) sauce|1 1/2 tsp celery salt|1 tspground red cayenne peppers
instructions: Add half amount of V8 juice to pitcher. Add all other ingredients, except vodka and stir vigorously. Add remaining amount of V8 juice and stir again. Add vodka; stir once more. Pour into ice-filled glasses, garnish with celery stalks and serve. (Serves 12-13)
shopping: vodka|V8(R) vegetable juice|horseradish|Worcestershire sauce|lime juice|Tabasco(R) sauce|celery salt|red cayenne peppers

name: Mango Colada
ingredients: 4 oz Captain Morgan(R) Parrot Bay mango rum|2 oz Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|8 oz Coco Lopez(R) cream of coconut|5 oz Dole(R) pineapple juice|3 oz mango nectar
instructions: Combine rums, cream of coconut, pineapple juice, and mango nectar in a regular sized blender. Blend on low speed about a minute. Fill with ice and blend on high speed until ice is grainy. Pour into a hurricane glass, garnish with a pineapple wedge, and serve.
shopping: Captain Morgan(R) Parrot Bay mango rum|Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|Coco Lopez(R) cream of coconut|Dole(R) pineapple juice|mango nectar

name: Applebee's Mango Martini
ingredients: 1 oz Captain Morgan(R) Parrot Bay mango rum|1/2 oz peach schnapps|1/2 oz Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|1 oz cranberry juice|1 oz pineapple juice
instructions: Combine all ingredients and shake lightly with ice. If you shake too hard the pineapple juice will get all foamy and will ruin the appearance (but not the taste) of the drink.^^^^Strain into a cocktail glass, splash with sprite and serve with an orange wedge.
shopping: Captain Morgan(R) Parrot Bay mango rum|peach schnapps|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|cranberry juice|pineapple juice

name: Rainbow Road
ingredients: 1/2 oz vodka|1/2 oz lemon liqueur|5 oz lemon-lime mix|1 splash Blue Curacao liqueur|1 splash melon liqueur|1 splash grenadine syrup
instructions: Shake the first three ingredients and pour into a lowball glass filled with cracked ice. On the left side add the splash of grenadine, in middle the splash of blue curacao and on the right side add the melon liqueur. Garnish with a cherry and a slice of lime.
shopping: vodka|lemon liqueur|lemon-lime mix|Blue Curacao liqueur|melon liqueur|grenadine syrup

name: Lemon Sherbert Punch
ingredients: 2 L Ginger ale, 7-UP or any clear soda|1 can frozen Pink lemonade|1 gal Sherbet, different flavors|Frozen Fruit|cold Water
instructions: Mix Lemonade in very large punch bowl. Add soda and frozen fruit. Open sherbet and dump the entire package of it into punch (it will float on the top). Due to the frozen fruit and Sherbet, there is really no need for ice until later, or unless it it very hot.

name: Old Nick
ingredients: 2 oz Canadian whisky|1/2 oz Drambuie(R) Scotch whisky|1/2 oz orange juice|1/2 oz lemon juice|3 dashes orange bitters
instructions: Combine the whisky, Drambuie, orange juice, lemon juice and orange bitters in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a twist of lemon and a maraschino cherry.
shopping: Canadian whisky|Drambuie(R) Scotch whisky|orange juice|lemon juice|orange bitters

name: Arizona Sunrise
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Tequila|1/2 oz Rose's sweetened lime juice|Grenadine|4 oz Orange juice
instructions: Add ice into a tall-stemed cocktail glass, pour grenadine over ice, add enough that some settles on the bottom of the glass Add tequila, orange juice, and lime juice into shaker with ice. Shake thourghly. Garnish with a straw, lime wedge OR orange and cherry.

name: Butt Naked Kiwi
ingredients: 2 cans Mountain Dew|2 shots Everclear (190 proof)|24 pieces Candy, Spree
instructions: Fill a resealable 32. oz container with one can of Mountain dew. Add the 2 shots of everclear then the second can of Mountain Dew. Add the sprees and shake until they turn white. Strain the mixture into the serving pitcher. Keep the sprees and eat them later.

name: Christmas Tree Water
ingredients: 1 part dry Gin|3 parts Sprite|1 dash Cayenne pepper (optional)
instructions: Place one part dry gin in Cocktail Glass. Do NOT bruise the Gin! Carefully add two parts Sprite. Do NOT bruise the Sprite. Optionally, add a dash of cayenne pepper for added flavor. Add 3 tablespoons of dry ice for that mystical, yet strangely, psycho effect.

name: Real Pisser
ingredients: 1/2 shot Tequila|1/2 shot Mountain Dew|Sugar|Maraschino cherry
instructions: In shot glass, pour 1/2 shot of Tequila, then 1/2 shot of Mountain Dew. Next, lick back of hand & sprinkle Sugar lightly onto it. Have Cherry ready on fork, laying on table. Lastly: lick sugar on hand, cover drink & slam on table, drink it fast, & eat cherry.

name: Sex in the Driveway
ingredients: 2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|2 oz peach schnapps|4 oz lime soda
instructions: Pour 2 equal parts of each Peach Schnapps and Blue Curacao into any form of drinking glass, best glass being a normal everyday drinking glass. Then add 4 parts Lime Crush and mix well. Then sit back and enjoy the soothing taste of liquid sex in your driveway.

name: Green Pussy #2
ingredients: 1/2 oz green creme de menthe|1/2 oz peppermint schnapps
instructions: The contributor had this in a bar in Toronto, Ont. Canada in 1991, apparently no bartender has known of it since. Tastes like Scope brand mouthwash, and goes down really nice. An awesome end of night drink.Stir ingredients together in a shot glass, and serve.

name: Green Summer
ingredients: 2 shots Coconut rum|12 oz Mountain Dew
instructions: Take an ordinary glass, and put in the two shots of coconut rum. Malibu or Coco Ribe will work nicely. Then pour in Mountain Dew. Make sure the Dew is chilled, or at least cold, and serve stirred, not shaken or strained. Adjust ingredient quantities to taste.

name: The Drink of Champions
ingredients: 2 oz Crown Royal|Dr. Pepper
instructions: Pour Crown Royal into beer mug (or whatever type of glass that is available). Fill with chilled Dr. Pepper or add ice cubes before pouring. Stir gently with fork, spoon, knife, toothbrush or whatever is handy or forget to stir and wait for surprise at bottom.

name: Mango Marimba
ingredients: 1 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|3/4 oz peach schnapps|1/4 oz Galliano(R) herbal liqueur|6 oz orange juice|1 splash Midori(R) melon liqueur|1 dash grenadine syrup
instructions: The Mango Marimba tastes like a mango smoothie, invented by Marco in late 80's and printed in Bartender Magazine. Popular in Beach Bars.Mix all ingredients in blender with crushed ice.Pour into 10 oz glass.top with speared fruit, mango & cherry or pineapple.
shopping: Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|peach schnapps|Galliano(R) herbal liqueur|orange juice|Midori(R) melon liqueur|grenadine syrup

name: Better Than Sex

instructions: Pour the Frangelico hazelnut liqueur, Haagen Dazs cream liqueur, Grand Marnier and Kahlua coffee liqueur into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Float the cream on top, and serve.
shopping: Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|Haagen Dazs(R) cream liqueur|Grand Marnier(R) orange liqueur|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|cream

name: Coqui
ingredients: 1/4 oz Midori(R) melon liqueur|1/4 oz pineapple rum|1/4 oz coconut rum|1/4 oz triple sec|1/4 oz peach schnapps|4 oz sweet and sour mix|1/2 oz lime juice
instructions: The Coqui is named after a tropical frog in Puerto Rico. As served at Dos Amigos in Waltham MA (the drink, not the frog). Courtesy of Annette Cruz.Fill a 16 oz glass with ice and add liquor, fill with sour mix box or shake the drink. Serve with a lime wedge.
shopping: Midori(R) melon liqueur|pineapple rum|coconut rum|triple sec|peach schnapps|sweet and sour mix|lime juice

name: Jailbreak

instructions: Jailbreak was invented in Burrell's Field, England. Vodka may be substituted for the whisky.Pump Guinness and Coke into a wine glass. Mix Kahlua, Jack Daniel's and Amaretto separately, with some crushed ice. Pour over the Guinness and Coke. Serve, unstirred.
shopping: Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|Jack Daniel's(R) Tennessee whiskey|amaretto almond liqueur|Guinness(R) stout|Coca-Cola(R)

name: Spiced Peach Punch
ingredients: 46 oz Peach nectar|20 oz Orange juice|1/2 cup Brown sugar, firmly packed|3 3-inch Cinnamon sticks|1/2 tsp Cloves|2 tblsp Lime juice
instructions: Combine peach nectar, orange juice and brown sugar in a large saucepan. Tie cinnamon and cloves in a small cheesecloth bag. Drop into saucepan. Heat slowly, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir in lime juice. Serve in hot mugs.

name: Orang-A-Tang
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|1 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum|1/2 oz triple sec|6 oz orange juice|1 splash sweet and sour mix|1 splash grenadine syrup
instructions: Pour the vodka, triple sec, orange juice, sour mix and grenadine into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a large brandy snifter half-filled with ice. Float the Bacardi 151 on top, garnish with tropical fruit, and serve.
shopping: vodka|Bacardi(R) 151 rum|triple sec|orange juice|sweet and sour mix|grenadine syrup

name: Cowgirl Quencher

instructions: Pour the Malibu coconut rum and DeKuyper Peachtree schnapps into a margarita glass filled with crushed ice. Fill the rest of the glass with equal parts of orange and pineapple juice. Add a splash of grenadine, top with an orange slice and a cherry and serve.
shopping: Malibu(R) coconut rum|DeKuyper(R) Peachtree schnapps|orange juice|pineapple juice|grenadine syrup

name: Dracona

instructions: Pour Adocaat and orange fruit juice straight into the glass, there will be a little curdling but dont worry. Add the ice cubes into the glass then Sambuca , slide creme de Menthe down the side. A yellow green yellow formation shouls occur, then add lemonade.

name: Kaali's Envy

instructions: In a cocktail shaker add pinepple pieces and muddle. Create as much juice as possible. Then add ice, midori, tequila and vanilla liqueur. Shake vigorously. Pour into hurricane glass and serve with a long teaspoon, straw and garnish with a piece of pineapple.

name: Tropics of Trogdor

instructions: The name comes from Strongbad's creature, Trogdor, because of the fire breathing effect you get afterwards.  Created by Emily M. McNamar.This drink is better mixed in bulk in equal parts then chilled (or strained over ice).  Poor into double shots and enjoy.
shopping: Absolut(R) Mandrin vodka|peach schnapps|Captain Morgan(R) Parrot Bay coconut rum

name: Lisa's Rooted Beer Float
ingredients: 2 oz root beer schnapps|1 oz vanilla schnapps|8 oz Coca-Cola(R)|2 tbsp whipped cream
instructions: First chill the Beer Mugs in the freezer. Place 2 oz. root beer schnapps in glass then the 1 oz. vanilla schnapps. Tilt glass and slowly pour in about 8 oz. of vanilla coke. Slowly set it upright and place two tablespoons of Cool Whip. Garnish with a cherry.

name: The Side Ponytail
ingredients: 35 ml sambuca|35 ml Bailey's(R) Irish cream|35 ml creme de bananes|hot chocolate
instructions: Add hot chocolate powder, the shot of sambuca, the shot of banana liqueur and the Bailey's Irish Cream to the mug. Fill with just boiling water. The drink should not take too long to cool, as the alcohol should be room temperature or chilled. Stir and enjoy.

name: Hot Apple Pie #5

instructions: Bring 1 gallon apple juice and 1 gallon apple cider to a boil on the stove. After it's boiling, add one cup sugar and 1 liter bottle of Absolute vodka. Remove from heat. Put back into 1 gallon jugs and place in fridge to cool. After it cools, serve it as is.

name: C&M

instructions: Fill cocktail glass with ice about halfway. Pour 2 - 3oz. of Malibu rum into the glass depending on the size of the glass. Pour 2 - 3oz. of Stoli Vanil depending on the size of the glass. Fill rest of glass with Coke (either regular or Diet your preference).

name: Burgundy Bomb

instructions: Pour cold red bull into rocks glass.^^^^Vombine Merlot and Stoli Raz with ice in a cocktail shaker.  Shake well and strain over the top of the Red Bull so as to mix the wine and vodka with the Red Bull nicely but not kill off the carbonation in the Red Bull.

instructions: Pour citrus punch and cola into a collins glass with a few ice cubes. Mix ingredients with a spoon, then add the whiskey. Mix again, then add apricot juice and stir very well, since it likes to settle on bottom of glass. Instructions may vary to your liking.

name: Real 57 Chevy

instructions: Combine the hazelnut liqueur, irish cream, Kahlua coffee liqueur, banana liqueur, banana and espresso in a blender with one cup of crushed ice. Blend until smooth. Swirl the chocolate sauce or syrup into a cocktail glass, and pour the mixture on top. Serve.
shopping: hazelnut liqueur|Irish cream|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|banana liqueur|banana|espresso|chocolate syrup

name: Buckshot

instructions: The Tequila and Whiskey are mixed in the bottom of the shot glass. The Baileys is to act like the 'wax' in a shotgun shell and is layered on top of the whiskey/tequila mix. The fresh ground pepper is your 'buckshot' that creates the spice/burning sensation.

name: Homemade Kahlua
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups Sugar|1 cup Corn syrup|1 1/2 oz instant Coffee|2 oz Vanilla extract|3 cups boiling Water|1 fifth Vodka
instructions: Dissolve sugar in 2 cups of boiling water and add corn syrup. Dissolve the instant coffee in the remaining water. Pour syrup and coffee in a gallon jug. Let it cool. Add vodka and vanilla when cold. For the best result, let the mixture mature for 4-5 weeks.

name: Dirty Sanchez

instructions: A coffee and cream tequila-based shot; be sure to take the Dirty Sanchez with a finger between nose and upper lip simulating a moustache!Pour the ingredients in equal parts into a cocktail shaker with some ice. Shake well, pour into shot glasses, and serve.
shopping: Bailey's(R) Irish cream|Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur

name: Funeral For A Friend

instructions: We came up with this one for our friend on his birthday. Layer the 151 on top of the Wild Turkey in one shot glass, and in a separate chilled shot glass put the Rumple Minze. Light the 151, blow it out and pour it into the glass with the Rumple Minze in it.
shopping: 151 proof rum|Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|Wild Turkey(R) bourbon whiskey

name: Pink Planet

instructions: Rim a wine glass with strawberry liqueur and caster sugar. Blend all ingredients (except champagne) briefly with three-quarters of a glassful of crushed ice. Pour into the glass and add champagne. Garnish with a strawberry-half, and serve with short straws.

name: Mandi Candy

instructions: Mandi Candy is a tasty strawberry/raspberry flavored shot drink. It was invented by bartender Mandi Z, Uncle Paulie's, Glen Ellyn, Illinois. Serve at room temperature or double-chilled, depending on taste.Mix ingredients together in a shot glass, and serve.
shopping: Stoli(R) Razberi vodka|Tequila Rose(R) strawberry cream liqueur

name: Trashcan Punch
ingredients: 3 parts Fruit punch|2 parts Everclear|1 part Fruit
instructions: Slice the fruit. I recommend strawberries, oranges, lemons, and limes. Then mix the punch and everclear together in a a CLEAN trashcan with ice. Hawaiin punch is my preference, but you can use any sort of fruit punch. Make sure you use ice and have a blast.

name: Appleschlager

instructions: Pour equal parts Goldschlager and apple vodka directly into a glass of your choice (brand of vodka also of your choice, although good quality vodka is recommended), make sure they have mixed thoroughly, and drink. Ice is optional; the drink is better cold.

instructions: Pour the rum, amaretto, orange juice and pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes, and float grenadine on top. Garnish with slices of orange, lemon or lime, and serve.
shopping: white rum|amaretto almond liqueur|orange juice|pineapple juice|grenadine syrup

name: Tea Toddy

instructions: Make tea as you usually do. Mix it with the sugar according to taste. Leave room in the cup for a dash of Baileys. Pour the baileys in according to taste, then, if you want, a dash of Whiskey if you want. Not too much though, as the drink won't taste good.

name: Naked Shake

instructions: Fill cocktail mixer with ice. Add the vanilla schnapps, Swiss Mocha Cream Liquor & a few ounces of half-and-half. Stir or shake and strain into ice filled highball glass. Top it off with a splash of coca-cola. Garnish with filbert nuts or cherries & serve!

name: Apple Jell-o Shots

shopping: DeKuyper(R) Sour Apple Pucker schnapps|sour apple jell-o|water

name: Captain Heron

instructions: Captain Heron is a combination of a fine coconut rum and Michigan's largest selling wine, Blue Heron.Pour Captain Morgan Parrot Bay into a highball glass until half-full. Fill the other half with Blue Heron Wine (Michigan). Add a squirt of lime, and serve.

shopping: dry vermouth|gin|creme de cassis|lemon juice|tonic water

name: Dusty Dog

instructions: Pour vodka, creme de cassis, lemon juice and bitters into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass almost-filled with ice cubes. Top with ginger ale, and stir well. Garnish with a twist of lemon, and serve.

name: Pink Cement
