instructions: Pink Cement is a delightful rendition of the Cement Mixer, as the two liqueurs coagulate into a semi-solid upon mixing. A really great revenge shot created by Mandi Z, Uncle Paulie's, Glen Ellyn, Illinois.Pour both ingredients into a shot glass, and serve.
shopping: Bacardi(R) Razz rum|Tequila Rose(R) strawberry cream liqueur

name: Vodkalenius
ingredients: 4 oz Vodka|1/2 oz Grenadine|4 oz Pineapple juice|1 tblsp Lingonberry jam
instructions: Stir all ingrediences with ice cubes and drink in a real Grogg-glass to get the wanted and expected effect. Let the lingonberry jam chill before mixing and make sure the vodka is below freezing to get a real lingonberry taste. One can us a straw if needed.

name: Pavlova Peach
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Stoli(R) Persik vodka|2 oz cranberry juice|2 oz orange juice
instructions: Pour the Stoli peach vodka (Persik), cranberry juice and orange juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with cracked ice. Shake well, and pour entire contents into a double old-fashioned glass with several ice cubes. Garnish with a peach slice, and serve.

name: Flaming Dr. Pepper (alternative)
ingredients: 1/2 oz Amaretto|1/2 oz Bacardi 151 proof rum|6 oz Lager
instructions: Put Amaretto in bottom of shot glass, top with Rum. Pour Beer into glass. Light shot, pick up shot by the sides and drop entire shot glass (bottom first) into beer. When bottom of shot glass hits bottom of beer glass chug (the beer will put out the flame).

name: Submarine (Mexican)
ingredients: 1 bottle Corona or Sol|1 shot Anejo Tequila
instructions: Fill a Shot with the Tequila and put the shot upside down inside the Beer Mug (make sure the Tequila stays inside the shot). Fill the Beer Mug with Beer. If you like salt on the edge of the Beer Mug you can add it. Also lemon can be added depending on you.

name: Reggae Cocktail
ingredients: 2 oz vodka|1/2 oz creme de bananes|1 oz orange juice|1/2 oz grapefruit juice|1/2 oz pineapple juice|1 dash orange bitters|1/2 tsp grenadine syrup
instructions: Pour vodka, creme de bananes, juices, bitters and grenadine into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a slice of orange, a pineapple wedge, and a maraschino cherry.
shopping: vodka|creme de bananes|orange juice|grapefruit juice|pineapple juice|orange bitters|grenadine syrup

name: Tinyee's Orange Smoothie
ingredients: Crushed Ice|1/2 cup Cointreau|Juice of 1/2 Lemon|1 cubed Mango|5 sliced Strawberries|1 can Lemon-lime soda|2 cups Orange juice
instructions: Put crushed ice into blender, about 2 cups. Add Cointreau. Add fruits, lemon juice and orange juice. Blend. With machine on, pour one half of the soda and reserve for serving. Once blended, pour into glass three-quarters of the way and add remaining soda.

name: Lone Tree Cooler
ingredients: Carbonated water|2 oz Gin|1 tblsp Dry Vermouth|1/2 tsp Powdered sugar|1 Orange spiral|1 twist of Lemon peel
instructions: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice, add gin and vermouth, and stir. Fill with carbonated water and stir again. Add the twist of lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end dangles over rim of glass.
shopping: Carbonated water|Gin|Dry Vermouth|Powdered sugar|Orange spiral|Lemon peel

name: Cosmopolitan Cocktail #5
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Smirnoff(R) vodka|1 1/2 oz triple sec|1/2 oz cranberry juice|1/2 ozfresh lime juice|1  orange
instructions: Combine the Smirnoff vodka, triple sec, fresh lime juice and cranberry juice in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well and strain into a frosted cocktail glass. Rub the rim with orange zest (if desired) and drop it into the glass. Serve.

name: Cafe Paloma
ingredients: 1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1 oz Grand Marnier(R) orange liqueur|6 oz coffee|whipped cream|cherries
instructions: Chrys Rodrigue, Los Angeles, a few Mexican restaurants in the San Fernando Valley that asked me to name my frequent request for hot coffee with Bailey's and Grand Marnier and a bunch of whipped cream.   Great winter drink!Pour two liqueurs into hot coffee

name: Orange Tootsie  Pop
ingredients: 2 oz Skyy(R) orange vodka|1 oz Godiva(R) chocolate liqueur|1 dash orange liqueur|1 pinch sugar
instructions: Pour orange vodka and Godiva into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake and allow to chill. Dip rim of a chilled cocktail glass into orange liqueur and twirl in sugar to coat. Pour contents of shaker into glass, garnish with an orange slice, and serve.
shopping: Skyy(R) orange vodka|Godiva(R) chocolate liqueur|orange liqueur|sugar

name: Strawberry Martini
ingredients: 1 1/2-2 oz Gin or vodka|1 tsp Dry Vermouth|1 tsp Grenadine (Rose's)|Sugar|Strawberries
instructions: Rub rim of chilled martini glass with a cut strawberry. Dip rim into a bowl of sugar until evenly coated. Pour Gin/Vodka, vermouth, and grenadine into a mixing glass with plenty of ice, and stir briskly. Strain into martini glass and drop in a strawberry.

name: Calpol
ingredients: 2 oz vodka|12 ozbottle Smirnoff(R) Ice|2 oz Red Bull(R) energy drink
instructions: Invented at Kent University in 2005. Named Calpol because thats what the contributor thought it tasted like. Very easy to drink, but with about 4 units it's strong stuff.Pour Smirnoff Ice into a pint glass. Add the vodka. Fill up with Red Bull, and serve.

name: Hot Port Flip
ingredients: 3 oz port|2 oz cream|1 pinch nutmeg|1 tspsuperfine sugar|1  egg
instructions: Warm port on the stove with in a saucepan. Be careful not to let it boil. Whisk the egg with sugar in a bowl and blend in 2oz. of cream. Pour the mixture into the saucepan with the port, stirring constantly. Serve in a warmed mug and sprinkle with nutmeg.

name: Didaccino
ingredients: 3 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|2 oz chocolate liqueur|5 oz milk
instructions: A chocolate and coffee-flavored digestif invented in the DIDA bar in Paris, France.Combine the Kahlua coffee liqueur, chocolate liqueur and milk in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake vigorously, pour into a coffee mug or glass, and serve.

name: Hawaiian Surfer on Acid
ingredients: 1 oz Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|1 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1/2 - 1/3 oz Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|2 oz pineapple juice
instructions: A refreshing drink, not too sweet.Mix all ingredients together in a cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes. Shake vigorously. Pour over ice cubes into an old-fashioned glass. It will be a bit frothy on top. Garnish with a cherry and lime wheel, and serve.
shopping: Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|Malibu(R) coconut rum|Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|pineapple juice

name: Chocolate Martini #4
ingredients: 1/2 oz Creme de Cacao|2 oz Vanilla vodka (Stoli)|Frost glass with Cocoa powder|Twist of Orange peel|5 - 6 cubes Ice
instructions: Pour the vodka and creme de cacao into a shaker with the ice cubes. Rub a slice of orange peel around the rim of the cocktail glass and dip the cocktail glass into the cocoa powder. Strain the liquid into the Cocktail glass. Garnish with the orange peel.
shopping: Creme de Cacao|Vanilla vodka|Cocoa powder|Orange peel|Ice

name: Hershey Highway
ingredients: 1 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|1 oz Irish cream|1 oz creme de cacao|5 oz chocolate milk|1 dash chocolate milk
instructions: Coat the bottom of a collins glass with chocolate syrup. Fill the glass half-way with ice cubes. Add Kahlua coffee liqueur, Irish cream and creme de cacao. Fill with chocolate milk and shake gently. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings if desired, and serve.
shopping: Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|Irish cream|creme de cacao|chocolate milk|chocolate milk

name: Flaming Flag
ingredients: 1/3 oz mint liqueur|1 splash 151 proof rum|1 splash triple sec|1/3 oz grenadine syrup|1/2 oz sugar syrup
instructions: Combine triple sec and sugar syrup in a separate glass. Pour grenadine into a shot glass, then layer the triple sec mixture on top. Layer mint liqueur on top. Top off with 151 and ignite. If done properly the shot should look like a mexican flag on fire.
shopping: mint liqueur|151 proof rum|triple sec|grenadine syrup|sugar syrup

name: The World's Best Pina Colada
ingredients: 6 oz Bacardi Black rum|8 oz Cream of coconut (Coco Lopes)|8 oz Pineapple juice|Ice|1 wedge Pineapple
instructions: Combine Rum, Cream of Coconut and Pineapple Juice in a regular sized blender. Blend on low speed to mix liquid ingredients. Fill blender to top with ice. Blend on high speed until ice is grainy. Pour into hurricane glass and garnish with pineapple wedge.

name: Aj Summer Drink
ingredients: 3 oz Grey Goose(R) vodka|1/2 ozfresh lemon juice|1/2 oz triple sec|7 fresh mint|1 oz simple syrup
instructions: Take a martini shaker add mint leaves & ice Muddle break down the mint too much. Then add Grey Goose vodka, fresh lemon juice, triple sec, simple syrup now add more ice cube.  Shake all ingredients together and strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Enjoy
shopping: Grey Goose(R) vodka|lemon juice|triple sec|mint|simple syrup

name: Wyncia
ingredients: 1 oz Fernet Branca(R) bitters|1 - 2 tsp lemon juice|1 nugget (1/2  per side) crystalized ginger
instructions: A very good drink for setting the stomach and the nerves.  It is popular in the Foothills of Colorado.Squeeze lemon juice into an attractive aperatif glass.  Drop in a nugget of crystalized ginger.  Add ice cubes.  Pour over shot of Fernet Branca.  Stir.

name: Alabama Afterburner
ingredients: 1 oz Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|12 ozcan Buffalo Rock(R) ginger ale
instructions: Alabama Afterburner requires Buffalo Rock Ginger Ale specifically--it's much spicier than your regular ginger ales. Unfortunately, you can only get it in Alabama.Put a shot of Captain in the bottom of a glass, then pour in the can of Buffalo Rock. Drink.
shopping: Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|Buffalo Rock(R) ginger ale

name: Boston Freeze
ingredients: 1 1/4 oz dark rum|3 oz cranberry juice|1 oz coconut cream
instructions: Pour dark rum, cranberry juice and coconut cream into a cocktail shaker with one cup of crushed ice. Shake well, until smooth. Pour all contents of the shaker into a wine glass. Garnish with 3 cranberries on a toothpick or a maraschino cherry, and serve.

name: Chocolate Kiss
ingredients: 1/2 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|1/2 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1/2 oz Tia Maria(R) coffee liqueur|1/2 oz Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|1/2 oz dark creme de cacao|1/2 oz cream
instructions: Chocolate Kiss is a delicious and now staple drink at The Villages bar, Florida where it was created by 'tender Jaime Lane.Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain into a martini cocktail glass, and serve.
shopping: Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|Bailey's(R) Irish cream|Tia Maria(R) coffee liqueur|Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|dark creme de cacao|cream

name: Jet Pilot
ingredients: 1 oz Spiced rum|1 oz Malibu rum|1 oz Rum (Bacardi)|1 oz Bacardi Limon|2 oz Cranberry juice|2 oz Orange juice|2 oz Pineapple juice|1 tsp Grenadine|2 oz Southern Comfort
instructions: Add ice cubes to a mason jar glass. Pour 1 oz of each type of rum over ice. Pour 2 oz's of each juice over ice. Add 1 tsp of grenadine. Top with double shot of southern comfort. More juice could be used to mask liquor. Drink can be stirred if preffered.
shopping: Spiced rum|Malibu rum|Rum|Bacardi Limon|Cranberry juice|Orange juice|Pineapple juice|Grenadine|Southern Comfort

name: Mulled Madeira
ingredients: 4 cups Madeira|6 tblsp Honey|2 tblsp Lemon juice|8 3x1/2 inch Orange peel strips|6 whole Cloves|1 stick Cinnamon, broken in half|1/2 cup Cointreau
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large saucepan and bring almost to simmer over medium heat. Reduce heat and cook for 10 minutes (do not simmer). Add Cointreau and stir until hot. Serve warm in heat proof glasses or mugs, leaving peel and spices in pan.

name: Nichols' Flaming Cocktail
ingredients: 1 oz Bacardi(R) Superior rum|1 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|1 ozsweetened condensed milk|5 oz cream soda|1/2 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum
instructions: Pour the Kahlua, condensed milk, cream soda and rum into a cocktail shaker with cubed ice and shake. Strain into a hurricane glass. Garnish with a maraschino cherry. If desired, layer Bacardi 151 on top and ignite. Enjoy fireshow, extinguish, and drink.
shopping: Bacardi(R) Superior rum|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|condensed milk|cream soda|Bacardi(R) 151 rum

name: Ten More Minutes
ingredients: 10 - 12 ozfrozen blueberries|10 - 12 ozfrozen raspberries|1  banana|2 1/2 oz vodka|2 1/2 oz rum|2 oz orange juice
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a blender with/without ice as desired. Blend until smooth. Coat the rim of an old-fashioned glass with sugar, and garnish with a slice of citrus fruit. Pour mixture from blender into glass, and serve. Should serve two or three.

name: Mojito #2
ingredients: 3 fresh Mint sprigs|2 tsp Sugar|3 tblsp fresh Lemon juice (or lime)|1 1/2 oz Light rum|Chilled Club soda
instructions: In a tall thin glass, crush part of the mint with a fork to coat the inside. Add the sugar and lemon juice and stir thoroughly. Top with ice. Add rum and mix. Top off with the club soda (or seltzer). Add a lemon slice and the remaining mint. Serves one.

name: Frozen Margarita #1
ingredients: 2 tsp coarse Salt|1 Lime wedge|3 oz white Tequila|1 oz Triple sec|2 oz Lime juice|1 cup crushed Ice
instructions: Place salt in a saucer. Rub rim of a cocktail glass with lime wedge and dip glass into salt to coat rim thoroughly, reserve lime. Pour tequila, triple sec, lime juice, and crushed ice into a blender. Blend well at high speed. Pour into a cocktail glass.

name: Beaubetween
ingredients: 1/2 oz peppermint schnapps|1/2 oz creme de cacao|1/2 oz Tequila Rose(R) strawberry cream liqueur
instructions: Three friends invented the Beaubetween around a campfire in Northern Ontario. It was originally called Cleavage however took on its new name which is not so obvious (Beau means nice).Pour the peppermint schnapps into a shot glass. Add the creme de cacao
shopping: then layer the tequila rose on top using the back of a spoon

name: Frozen Margarita
ingredients: 2 tspcoarse salt|1  lime|3 oz white tequila|1 oz triple sec|2 oz lime juice|1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Place salt in a saucer. Rub rim of a cocktail glass with lime wedge and dip glass into salt to coat rim thoroughly, reserve lime. Pour tequila, triple sec, lime juice, and crushed ice into a blender. Blend well at high speed. Pour into a cocktail glass.

name: Berta's Special
ingredients: 2 oz tequila|1 tsp honey|6 dashes orange bitters|1  egg|1 1/2 oz lime juice|soda water
instructions: Combine the tequila, honey, orange bitters, egg white and lime juice in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake vigorously, and strain into a collins glass filled with ice cubes. Fill with soda water, garnish with a slice of lime, and serve.

name: Jack-Off
ingredients: 1 shot Jack Daniels|1/2 can Coca-Cola|2 shots Iced tea|Ice
instructions: Pour in one shot of Jack Daniel's on ice, more if you like your drinks strong. Then pour about a half of a can of Coca-Cola on top, leaving room for the iced tea. Finally, fill to the top with very strong iced tea (try three times the amount of powder).

name: Arizona Stingers
ingredients: 2 shots Absolut Vodka|12 oz lemon Iced tea
instructions: Place ice cubes in the hurricane glass . Add the 2 HEAPING shots of Absolute Vodka (Note: You can add as many shots of Absolute as you want!) Fill the rest of glass with the Arizona Icetea with lemon. Stir to mix using a spoon. Drink up and enjoy!!!!!!!

name: Christina Ricci Cocktail
ingredients: 1 glass Scotch whisky|1 tbspblack coffee
instructions: This drink is from an Oakland University graduate student (Mark Katakowski), who in a dream was taught how to make it by the actress Christina Ricci.Pour the Scotch whisky into a whiskey sour glass filled with ice. Add the spoonful of coffee, and serve.

name: Captain Jack Sparrow #2
ingredients: 2 oz Cabo Wabo(R) anejo tequila|1 oz Captain Morgan(R) Private Stock dark rum|3 oz Minute Maid(R) limeade soda|1 splash maraschino cherry juice|1/2 oz 99 Oranges(R) orange schnapps|2  maraschino cherries
instructions: Drop the cherries and some ice into a highball glass. Pour the Cabo Wabo anejo tequila, Captain Morgan Private Stock dark rum, Minute Maid limeade and 99 Oranges orange schnapps into the glass. Add a splash of maraschino cherry juice on top, and serve.
shopping: Cabo Wabo(R) anejo tequila|Captain Morgan(R) Private Stock dark rum|Minute Maid(R) limeade soda|maraschino cherry juice|99 Oranges(R) orange schnapps|maraschino cherries

name: Bailey's Banana Vanilla Thrilla
ingredients: 7 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1 cup coconut milk|1  banana|1 pinchshredded coconuts|2 dropsyellow food coloring|6  ice cubes|2 scoops vanilla ice cream|2 tsp sugar
instructions: Add all liquids in blender with banana and ice cream; blending until smooth. Add ice and sugar, and pulse until a smoothie consistency is reached. Garnish with coconut. Makes 2-3 500ml servings. For a fancier garnish, use the head of a tropical flower.
shopping: Bailey's(R) Irish cream|coconut milk|banana|coconuts|food coloring|ice cubes|vanilla ice cream|sugar

name: Canadian Salad
ingredients: 1 oz Canadian whisky|1/2 oz brandy|1/2 oz Irish Mist(R) herbal liqueur|1/2 oz Scotch whisky|1 oz orange juice|1/2 oz lemon juice|1/2 tsp superfine sugar
instructions: Add the whiskies, brandy, Irish Mist, juices, and sugar to a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a slice of orange and a maraschino cherry, and serve.
shopping: Canadian whisky|brandy|Irish Mist(R) herbal liqueur|Scotch whisky|orange juice|lemon juice|superfine sugar

name: Pain d'Epices
ingredients: 1 2/3 oz Havana Club(R) Anejo Especial rum|1 oz Pedro Ximinez sherry|1/2 oz Monin(R) gingerbread syrup|1 - 1 1/2 ozfreshly squeezed orange juice
instructions: Chill a martini glass. Pour the rum, Pedro Ximenez and Monin pain d'epices (gingerbread) syrup over ice in a mixing glass. By hand, squeeze the juice from half an orange into the glass. Stir slowly and at length. Strain into a martini glass, and serve.
shopping: Havana Club(R) Anejo Especial rum|Pedro Ximinez sherry|Monin(R) gingerbread syrup|orange juice

name: Pan-Galactic Gargle Blaster
ingredients: 1 oz Jack Daniel's(R) Tennessee whiskey|1 oz peach schnapps|4 - 6 oz orange juice|1 splash Blue Curacao liqueur
instructions: The Pan-Galactic Gargle Blaster is The best [fictional] drink in existence and appears many times in the series The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy where its effect is described as being rather like having your brains smashed out with a slice of lemon
shopping: wrapped around a large gold brick. Due to the large fan base of this excellent franchise and the fact that no official (and actually pursuable) recipe for one was ever given by Douglas Adams the writer

name: Brandy Swizzle
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Lime juice|1 tsp superfine Sugar|2 oz Brandy|1 dash Bitters|crushed Ice|3 oz Club soda
instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the lime juice, sugar, brandy, and bitters. Shake well. Almost fill a collins glass with crushed ice and stir until glass is frosted. Strain the mixture in the shaker into the glass and add the club soda.

name: Gumdrop Cocktail
ingredients: 2 oz amarula cream liqueur|1 oz butterscotch schnapps|2 oz cream|1 dash Blue Curacao liqueur
instructions: Pour the amarula cream liqueur, cream and butterscotch schnapps into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and pour a dash of blue curacao down two opposite sides of the glass (using a teaspoon).
shopping: amarula cream liqueur|butterscotch schnapps|cream|Blue Curacao liqueur

name: Watermelon Margarita
ingredients: 16 oz seeded and blended Watermelon|1/2 Lime|6 oz Tequila|3 oz Triple sec|1 tblsp Sugar
instructions: Cut up watermelon, removing seeds. Liquify in blender until you have about 16 oz. Add remaining ingredients, top with ice and blend until smooth. Taste and add sugar if watermelon is not sweet enough. This works well with sugar on the rim of the glass.

name: Brandy Blazer
ingredients: 1 tsp granulated Sugar|2 oz Brandy|1 slice Orange|1 twist of Lemon peel
instructions: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in brandy. Add the orange slice. Tilt the glass and carefully ignite the drink with a match. Stir with a long spoon until the flame is extinguished. Strain into a punch cup and garnish with the lemon twist.

name: Piper At The Gates Of Dawn
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Scotch|1 oz Kahlua|1/2 oz Maraschino liqueur|1 oz Heavy cream
instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch, Kahlua, and maraschino liqueur. Stir well. Strain into old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Pour the cream over the back of a teaspoon so that it floats on top of the drink.

name: White Mexican
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|2 oz Horchata
instructions: Pour vodka and Baileys over ice in cocktail glass. The more ice the better. Top off with Horchata (Mexican rice soft drink) and garnish with 2 stir straws. Do not stir. Cocktail has a double layer effect. Allow consumer to stir if he/she would like to.

name: Pink Paradise
ingredients: 2 oz tequila|3 dashes bitters
instructions: Pour the tequila into a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, and stir. Pour the bitters into a brandy snifter and swirl around in order to coat the glass. Discard any excess bitters from the glass, then strain the tequila into the glass, and serve.

name: Wasabi Bloody Mary
ingredients: 1/2 fresh lime juice|4 1/2 tsp wasabi|6 cupslow-salt V8(R) vegetable juice|3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce|1 1/4 tsp hot pepper sauce|3/4 tsp salt|1 1/2 cups vodka
instructions: Combine lime juice and wasabi with a whisk, until wasabi dissolves. Pour into a pitcher, and add veggie juice, worcestershire sauce, pepper sauce and salt. Chill. Stir in vodka and serve over ice, with a stalk of celery or pickled asparagus. Serves 8.
shopping: lime juice|wasabi|V8(R) vegetable juice|Worcestershire sauce|hot pepper sauce|salt|vodka

name: Blue Lagoon Margarita
ingredients: 1 1/4 oz Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila|3/4 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|1 splash 7-Up(R) soda|1 splash Rose's(R) lime juice|pineapple juice
instructions: Pour the Jose Cuervo gold tequila, blue curacao, 7-Up and Rose's lime juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Add pineapple juice to taste, and shake vigorously. Strain into an old-fashioned glass 1/4 filled with ice cubes, and serve.
shopping: Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila|Blue Curacao liqueur|7-Up(R) soda|Rose's(R) lime juice|pineapple juice

name: Oz Dust
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz DeKuyper(R) Sour Apple Pucker schnapps|1 oz Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps|1/2 oz vodka|1 splash 7-Up(R) soda
instructions: An apple-cinnamon flavored drink with a gold and ice sparkle.Pour both schnapps' and vodka into a cocktail shaker half-filled with crushed ice. Shake until bruised. Strain into a Champagne saucer or martini cocktail glass. Top off with 7-up or Sprite.
shopping: DeKuyper(R) Sour Apple Pucker schnapps|Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps|vodka|7-Up(R) soda

name: Red Dog
ingredients: 1/2 oz orange vodka|2 oz Crown Royal(R) Canadian whisky|3 oz ginger ale|1 1/2 oz orange juice|1 1/2 oz cranberry juice
instructions: Pour vodka and whiskey into a cocktail shaker. Add orange and cranberry juice, and shake vigorously. Pour over ice in a frozen or chilled collins glass or tumbler. Slowly add the ginger ale, garnish with a maraschino cherry or orange wedge, and serve.
shopping: orange vodka|Crown Royal(R) Canadian whisky|ginger ale|orange juice|cranberry juice

name: Beachcomber
ingredients: 2 tsp superfine Sugar|1 Lime wedge|2 oz Light rum|1 tsp Maraschino liqueur|1 tsp Cherry brandy|1/2 oz Lime juice
instructions: Place sugar in a saucer. Rub the rim of a cocktail glass with lime wedge and dip glass into sugar to coat rim thoroughly, reserve lime. In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine rum, maraschino liqueur, cherry brandy, and lime juice. Shake well.

name: Sazerac
ingredients: 1 tsp Ricard|1/2 tsp superfine Sugar|2 dashes Peychaud bitters|1 tsp Water|2 oz Bourbon|1 twist of Lemon peel
instructions: Pour Ricard into a glass and swirl around to coat glass, discard any excess. Place the sugar, Peychaud bitters, and water int othe glass and muddle with the back of a teaspoon. Almost fill the glass with ice cubes. Pour the bourbon over the ice cubes.

name: Astronaut
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz vodka|1 1/2 oz light rum|1 1/2 oz dark rum|4 - 5 oz Sprite(R) soda|1 splash pineapple juice
instructions: Pour the vodka, light rum and dark rum into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Add Sprite and a splash of pineapple juice. Serve with a twist of lime (or lemon), and serve.

name: Liquid Big Red
ingredients: 2 oz Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps|2 oz Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|12 oz Dr. Pepper(R) soda
instructions: Retrieve your choice cup and add ice. Once the ice is in, add the 2 oz. Goldschlager and then add the 2 oz. Jagermeister. Pour Dr. Pepper until the cup is full. Make sure to check out the foam, there should be gold flecks sitting on top of your drink.
shopping: Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps|Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|Dr. Pepper(R) soda

name: Snapple sensation
ingredients: 2 parts Mango Madness Snapple|2 parts Jack Daniels sour mash whiskey|4 drops Lime juice
instructions: Mix the Snapple and whiskey in a pewter martini shaker. (preferably pewter because it keeps the drink so cold). Next step put crushed ice in very last so you do not water down the drink. Serve in a martini glass or a huricane glass with 4 lemon drops.

name: Nummer 10
ingredients: Aprox 6 cl Raspberry vodka|3-5 drops Kahlua|Fill with Schweppes Russchian
instructions: Fill the glass up to 1/3 with raspberry vodka. Scatter a few drops of Kalhua into the raspberry vodka and mix it. Be careful, it?s important not to get to much Kalhua. Fill up the glass with Schweppes Russchian and the Nummer 10(C) is complete. Enjoy!

name: Pink Bliss
ingredients: 1 oz Smirnoff(R) vodka|5 oz Schweppes(R) pink lemonade|1 squeeze lemons
instructions: Pour Smirnoff vodka into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Add a large squeeze of lemon juice; this un-bitters the Vodka taste, if you want it sweeter. Fill to the top with Schweppes pink lemonade, and serve. Comes out a transperant pink colour!

name: Peach Blossom #2
ingredients: 1 - 2 oz peach schnapps|6 oz grapefruit juice|1/2 oz grenadine syrup
instructions: The Peach Blossom drink comes from restaurant at one of the restored mansions in New Orleans about 20 years ago. Great summer drink.Put ice in glass. Add peach schnapps, then grapefruit juice. Add 1/2 shot of grenedine. Stir and top with fruit garnish

name: Orange Hawaiian
ingredients: 100 ml Bacardi(R) orange rum|3 litersbottle Hawaiian Punch(R)
instructions: Pour the Bacardi O orange-flavored rum into a blender. Add ice, enough so that it will be slushy when you drink it. Pour in as much Hawaiian punch as you can, and blend. Pour into a pitcher, make a glass for yourself, and store the rest in the fridge.

name: Jerry's Mom
ingredients: 3 oz Everclear(R) alcohol|1 scoop Ben & Jerry's(R) ice cream
instructions: Jerry's Mom can be made with any flavor ice cream, typically strawberry or chocolate chip. One can drink it fast with a mouthful of ice cream, or set it on fire, or even mix it.Pour everclear into an old-fashioned glass, top with ice cream, and serve.

name: Cream Sherry Cobbler
ingredients: 2 1/2 oz cream sherry|1 tsp superfine sugar|3 oz club soda
instructions: Add the sugar to an old-fashioned glass. Pour in the club soda, and stir to dissolve. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full, then add sherry, and stir well. Garnish with a maraschino cherry, a slice of orange, and a slice of lemon, and serve.

name: El Chupacabras
ingredients: 1/2 oz Patron(R) silver tequila|1/2 oz Agavero(R) tequila liqueur|1 splash lemon juice|1 splash lime juice|1/2 oz mango juice|1 splash Dr. Pepper vanilla soda|1 drop Tapatio(R) hot sauce

name: Kentucky Classic
ingredients: 1 ozstraight kentucky bourbon whiskey|5 - 6 oz Ale-8-One(R) soda
instructions: Ale-8-One is a soda native to Kentucky. It is available only in Kentucky, and southern parts of Ohio and Indiana. It is similar to Ginger Ale with a hint of fruit flavor. Add Bourbon and Ice to glass and fill with Ale-8-One. Gently stir and serve.

name: Italian Greyhound
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz vodka|1/2 oz Campari(R) bitters|5 oz grapefruit juice
instructions: An extension on the Greyhound drink, popular in summer. Credit to Andrew Hildebrand, a bartender at the W hotel, San Diego.Stir the vodka and grapefruit juice together in a highball glass. Float the Campari over a barspoon onto the top, and serve.

name: Monkey Brain #1
ingredients: 2 cl Apfelkorn (apple liquor)|Bailey's irish cream
instructions: Fill a shot glass with Apfelkorn almost to the rim. Then, very carefully pour a little Bailey's into the glass. The two liquors don't mix at if poured correctly, and the Bailey's will sink to the bottom as a nasty looking blob, not unlike a brain.

name: Jolly Rancher #5
ingredients: 2 oz vodka|1 jolly rancher candy|4 oz 7-Up(R) soda
instructions: Mix vodka of your choice with the contents of a jolly rancher freeze pop treat, unfrozen, using your choice of flavor, add ice and 7 Up. If you find it too sweet substitute soda water for 7Up. You can also use frozen freeze pop pieces as ice cubes

name: Pick Me Up Jose
ingredients: 1/2 oz Bacardi 151 proof rum|1/2 oz Jose Cuervo
instructions: Lay shot glass in a CLEAN ash tray right side up, and start to pour the drinks into te glass till they overflow into the ash tray. then light the liquer on fire, blow it out, take the shot from the shot glass, then drink out of the ash tray. ENJOY

name: Alexi's Spicy Bloody Mary
ingredients: 1 oz Absolut(R) vodka|4 dashes Worcestershire sauce|4 dashes Tabasco(R) sauce|2 dashes pickle juice|2 dashes olive juice|fill with tomato juice|salt|pepper|celery salt
instructions: Add vodka, sauces, pickle juice and brine to a mug full of ice. Fill with tomato juice. Add salt, pepper and celery salt to taste. Pour mixture back and fourth between two glasses to mix it well. Garnish with olives, a pickle and a slice of lime.
shopping: Absolut(R) vodka|Worcestershire sauce|Tabasco(R) sauce|pickle juice|olive juice|tomato juice|salt|pepper|celery salt

name: Cream Sherry Sangaree
ingredients: 2 oz cream sherry|1/2 oz benedictine herbal liqueur|1 tsp superfine sugar|2 tsp water|2 1/2 oz club soda|1 pinchgrated nutmeg|1 pinchground cinnamon
instructions: Add the sugar to a highball glass. Add water and sherry, and stir to dissolve sugar. Almost fill the glass with crushed ice, and add club soda. Float the benedictine on top. Garnish with a lemon twist, a dusting of nutmeg and cinnamon, and serve.
shopping: cream sherry|benedictine herbal liqueur|superfine sugar|water|club soda|nutmeg|cinnamon

name: Orange Fizz
ingredients: 2 oz gin|2 tbsp lemon juice|2 tsp triple sec|1 1/2 tsp simple syrup|2 dashes orange bitters|1 splash orange juice|3 - 5 oz soda water
instructions: Add the gin, lemon juice, triple sec, simple syrup and orange bitters to a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a sour glass. Fill with soda, and top with orange juice. Garnish with a slice of orange, and serve.
shopping: gin|lemon juice|triple sec|simple syrup|orange bitters|orange juice|soda water

name: 1800 Mint Lemonade
ingredients: 1.5 oz 1800(R) Reposado Tequila|1 ozfresh lemon juice|1 oz simple syrup|1 oz club soda|6 medium-sized mint|garnish with lemon
instructions: In a tall mixing glass muddle mint with simple syrup. Add 1800(R) Reposado and lemon juice then add ice and shake vigorously. Strain over fresh ice into a Collins glass and top with club soda. Garnish with a wheel of lemon and a fresh mint sprig.

name: Dreamsicle #6
ingredients: 2 oz Dr. Mcgillicuddy's(R) Vanilla Schnapps|2 1/2 oz100% Tropicana(R) orange juice|4 splashes half-and-half
instructions: In a glass filled half way with ice, add 2 oz Dr. McGillicuddy's Vanilla Liqueur, Then add 2 1/2 oz of Tropicana 100% Orange Juice. Add 4-5 splashes of Half and Half. Shake well and drink from glass or serve as shots. Pour out ice before serving!
shopping: Dr. Mcgillicuddy's(R) Vanilla Schnapps|Tropicana(R) orange juice|half-and-half

name: Smooth Pineapple Daiquiri
ingredients: 8 slicescanned pineapples|6 oz light rum|6 ozcan frozen limeade|2/3 cup vanilla ice cream|1/2 - 1 cup ice
instructions: Combine limeade and rum in a blender. Add pineapple and ice cream. Blend well. With the blender running, add a few pieces of ice. Continue adding ice until the mixture is smooth and thick and the blender is nearly full. Serve in cocktail glasses.

name: Spank the Monkey
ingredients: 3/4 oz 99 Bananas(R) banana schnapps|3/4 oz Smirnoff(R) Vanilla Twist vodka|1/2 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum
instructions: In a double shot glass, add .75oz of 99 Bananas with .75oz of Smirnoff Vanilla then SPANK the monkey with .5oz of Bacardi.  If the glass is clear the drink will actually look  banana yellow.  Now it is time to get in touch with your inner primate
shopping: take the shot and be prepared to go ape sh*t!

name: Bloody Mary #4
ingredients: 2 oz lemon vodka|4 oz tomato juice|1/4 tspminced, fresh dill|1 slice lemon
instructions: Combine lemon vodka, tomato juice and dill (use a dash of dried if no fresh available) in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Float a slice of lemon on top, and serve.

name: Ikonoclast
ingredients: 3 oz Ikon(R) vodka|1/3 oz creme de cacao|1 oz whipped cream|1  cranberry
instructions: Pour the Ikon vodka and creme de cacao into a cocktail or martini shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and pour into a chilled cocktail or martini glass. Top with three swirls of whipped cream and a cranberry rolled in sugar, and serve.

name: Pimp Slap
ingredients: 2 - 3 oz Pimp(R) apple juice|1 oz Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur
instructions: Fill shot glass with jagermiester, then place inside lowball glass, pour Pimp Juice into lowball glass around shot glass to its rim.... swirl so some of the jager floats at the top of the pimp juice... then bar keep slaps parton for extra kick!!!

name: Fruit Tingle
ingredients: 30 ml Blue Curacao|30 ml Raspberry cordial|Lemonade|Ice
instructions: Pour Curacao over ice in a tumbler. Add Raspberry cordial and Lemonade at the same time so that the combined effect mixes the drink. Consume!!! The drink is meant to taste like the lollies called Fruit Tingles, and it succeeds very well in this..

name: Apple Pie Shot #1
ingredients: 1 shot Apple juice|1 shot Vodka|A dash of Cinnamon
instructions: Pour one shot of Apple Juice and another of Vodka. Sprinkle cimmamon on the tougue and pour both shots into your mouth. Without drinking, shake your head until cimmamon is dissovled and drink. (Repeat if nessesary....or unconscious on the floor.)

name: Bruce's Puce
ingredients: Grenadine|Kahlua|Bailey's irish cream
instructions: In a regular-sized shot glass, layer, with a spoon or cherry, the grenadine , the Kahlua , then the Bailey's Irish cream in equal portions. It goes down really smooth ,and you don't even need a chaser. It tastes just like chocolate milk.(Really!)

name: Kill 'em with Kindness
ingredients: 1 oz amaretto almond liqueur|1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1 oz Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|1 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|1 oz butterscotch schnapps|1/2 tsp caramel syrup|1/4 tsp vanilla extract|1 splash whipped cream
instructions: Make a spiral with the caramel around the inside of the glass. In a shaker with ice, combine the Amaretto, Bailey's, Frangelico, Kahlua, butterscotch schnapps and vanilla extract. Strain into previously prepared glass and top with whipped cream.
shopping: amaretto almond liqueur|Bailey's(R) Irish cream|Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|butterscotch schnapps|caramel syrup|vanilla extract|whipped cream

name: Quelude
ingredients: 1 oz gin|1 oz light rum|1 oz vodka|1 oz triple sec|1 splash grenadine syrup|2 drops DeKuyper(R) Razzmatazz liqueur|2 drops Blue Curacao liqueur|4 - 6 oz sweet and sour mix
instructions: In a beer mug with ice, add gin, rum, vodka, and triple sec. Fill almost to the top with the sour mix. Grenadine is optional. Pour the Razzmatazz and Blue Curacao on opposite sides. It should be blue and red with a margarita color in the middle.
shopping: gin|light rum|vodka|triple sec|grenadine syrup|DeKuyper(R) Razzmatazz liqueur|Blue Curacao liqueur|sweet and sour mix

name: Homemade Advocaat
ingredients: 1 1/4 cup granulated Sugar|3/4 tsp Vanilla extract|1/2 tsp Lemon extract|1 cup Vodka|5 Egg|1 Egg yolk|2/3 cup evaporated Milk
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender for 30 seconds until they are mixed well. Pour into container, cap and refrigerate. Let it age for 1 to 2 weeks to mellow. The color will intensify as it ages, reaching a more traditional light shade of yellow.

name: Dephaekt
ingredients: 4 cl Absolut Kurant|1,5 cl Orgeat syrup|1 cl Frangelico|Fill with 2/3 Cranberry juice|Fill with 1/3 Sprite
instructions: Blend the Absolut kurant, Oregat and Frangelico in a mixer. Pour in highball glass, add 2 icecubes, fill with the cranberryjuice and sprite. Put a slice of lemon on the edge of the glass. Optional to add a dash of lime for an even fresher taste.

name: N'awlins Mudslide
ingredients: 1 oz Praline New Orleans-style pecan liqueur|1 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream
instructions: Invented by John Juneau, making a contribution to re-build New Orleans.Add ice to an old-fashioned glass and add all three ingredients. Swirl the glass to blend the colors. Prolonged sipping is suitable or drink it like a shot. Savor the flavor!
shopping: Praline New Orleans-style pecan liqueur|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|Bailey's(R) Irish cream

name: Blazing Fire
ingredients: Ice|1 part Vodka|1 part Gin|1 part Light rum|1 part Triple sec|Pineapple juice|1 dash Grenadine
instructions: In mixing glass, pour in equal parts vodka, gin, rum, and triple sec. Add pineapple juice and a hearty dash of grenadine for color. Shake and strain over ice, garnish with orange and cherry spear. It should come out a bright, fiery orange color.

name: Metropolis
ingredients: 5 oz Vodka (Vox)|2 oz Blue Curacao (Dekyper)|1 oz Razzmatazz|1/2 oz Cranberry vodka (Finlandia)
instructions: In a shaker, combine Vodka and blue curacao. Chill until cloudy. Pour into martini glass. Tilt glass and pour in raspberry schnapps (will sink to the bottom). Float cranberry vodka on top. This will give you levels of color: red - blue - purple.

name: Minas Morgul
ingredients: 2 oz Finlandia(R) vodka|2 oz Rumple Minze(R) peppermint liqueur|2 oz Romana(R) black sambuca
instructions: Minas Morgul is named after a location in J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of The Rings which was the base of operation for the evil Nazgul.Chill all ingredients beforehand. Make sure drink appears as a black tower. Fill glass in whatever order desired

name: Edward's Purple Medicine
ingredients: 1/2 oz Avalanche(R) peppermint schnapps|1/2 oz Aftershock(R) Hot & Cool cinnamon schnapps
instructions: Edward's Purple Medicine has different effects according to the shape of the shot glass, mostly turning dark purple, sometimes looking like it has an eyeball in it. It was created by a guy who calls himself Edward the Slightly Confused. Confused
shopping: anyone?Pour either ingredient into a shot glass first

name: Tequila Bang Bang Mexico Style
ingredients: 1/2 oz Jose Cuervo(R) Clasico silver tequila|1/4 oz grenadine syrup|1/4 oz Sprite(R) soda
instructions: I had this drink when I went to mexico on my all inclusive stay at the hotel.  The bartender knew what to give me when I got there!  Seis Cervezas por favor y tres tequila  bang bangs! Areba!Make sure to have a taller shot glass.  Put tequila in

name: Old-Fashioned Cocktail
ingredients: 2 oz blended whiskey|1  sugar|1 dash bitters|1 slice lemon|1  cherry|1 slice orange
instructions: Combine the sugar cube, bitters, and 1 tsp. water in an old-fashioned glass. Muddle well, add blended whiskey, and stir. Add a twist of lemon peel and ice cubes. Add slices of orange and lemon and top with the cherry. Serve with a swizzle stick.

name: A True Amaretto Sour
ingredients: 1 jigger Amaretto|Juice of 1/2 Lemon|Ice|Maraschino cherry
instructions: Rub the rim of an old fashioned glass with lemon, and dip repeatedly into granulated sugar until it has a good frosted rim. Shake a jigger of Amaretto with the juice of 1/2 a lemon. Strain into glass and add ice. Garnish with a Marachino Cherry.

name: Rhubarb Syrup
ingredients: 1 lb Rhubarb|1 cup Water|2 cups Sugar|2 tblsp Rosewater
instructions: Remove strings from rhubarb, wash, and cut into 1/2 pieces. Wrap rhubarb in cheesecloth and tie shut. Bring sugar and water to boil. Put cheesecloth in the syrup and simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes or until it thickens. Remove cheesecloth
shopping: squeeze it to get the juice out. Pour syrup into a clean

name: Gin Bucket
ingredients: 1 L Gin (Beefeater)|1 can frozen Fruit punch concentrate|1 can frozen Lemonade concentrate|1 can frozen Limeade concentrate|1 bottle diced Cherries
instructions: For the full effect you should use a large Folgers coffee can or a metal bucket. First, fill the can half full with ice and add the gin(the whole bottle). Next, add the concentrates and cherries. Finally, shake the can until its ready to drink.

name: Buzz Lightyear #2
ingredients: 1/2 oz vodka|1/2 oz Midori(R) melon liqueur|1/2 oz Barenjager(R) honey liqueur|1/4 oz sweet and sour mix|1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur
instructions: I created the drink based on a popular saying from the movie. When someone orders the drink they must call out a toast: TO INFINITY AND BEYOND.  With some help from my close friend Mike Johnson.  If the chicks you bought this for love Toy Story

name: Queen's Park Swizzle
ingredients: 2 oz dark rum|2 dashes Angostura(R) bitters|1/2 oz sugar syrup|juice of 1/2 limes|4  mint|2 oz soda water
instructions: Squeeze lime juice into a highball glass. Add the shell, fill with crushed ice and add the mint. Pour in the rum, angostura bitters and sugar syrup. Swizzle until glass frosts. Add the soda, garnish with a sprig of mint, and serve with a straw.

name: Whiskey Collins
ingredients: 2 oz Blended whiskey|1 tsp Powdered sugar|Juice of 1/2 Lemon|Carbonated water|1 Cherry|1 slice Orange
instructions: Shake blended whiskey, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a collins glass. Add several ice cubes, fill with carbonated water, and stir. Decorate with slices of orange, lemon, and top with the cherry. Serve with a straw.

name: Red Moon
ingredients: 1 oz peach schnapps|1 oz vodka|4 oz 7-Up(R) soda|1  maraschino cherry|1 dash maraschino cherry juice
instructions: Great on a full moon party night - sweet and simple.  Made by Kim Soon-Chon at The Blue Agave Cantina, Jeju, South Korea.Fill glass with ice, add booze and top off with 7-up.  Throw in a cherry and a dash of the maraschino juice for some color.
shopping: peach schnapps|vodka|7-Up(R) soda|maraschino cherry|maraschino cherry juice

name: Refresher #2
ingredients: 3 oz Aftershock(R) Cool Citrus mint schnapps|9 oz WKD(R) Original Vodka Blue|4 oz Strongbow(R) cider
instructions: Put ice in a pint glass and add three shots of blue aftershock. Then put in a full bottle of WKD Blue, then add Strongbow cider to take the drink to the top of the glass. Give it a good stir and serve, it tastes exactly like refresher sweets!!!
shopping: Aftershock(R) Cool Citrus mint schnapps|WKD(R) Original Vodka Blue|Strongbow(R) cider

name: Vodka Pina Colada
ingredients: 2 oz vodka|1 1/3 oz coconut cream|2 2/3 oz pineapple juice|1 tsp whipping cream|1/2 oz caster sugar
instructions: Add ingredients to a shaker and swirl until sugar is dissolved. Sweeten further if needed. Shake briefly with a glassful of crushed ice, and strain into a pina colada glass. Garnish with a slice of pineapple and a cherry, add straws, and serve.

name: Ladybird
ingredients: 1 oz brandy|1 1/2 oz creme de cassis|1 oz half-and-half|1/4 tsp chocolate powder
instructions: Fill a cocktail shaker half with ice cubes. Add brandy, cassis and half-and-half. Shake vigorously. Strain into chilled cocktail glass, serve straight-up. Garnish with chocolate powder (try to create dots, like on a ladybird beetle for effect).

name: Apple Mojito
ingredients: 2 oz Bacardi(R) Big Apple rum|6 oz club soda|3  lime|2 tsp sugar|3 fresh mint
instructions: Add the lime, sugar and mint sprigs to a highball glass and muddle with a muddler. Add several ice cubes and pour in the Bacardi apple rum. Top with club soda (adjust to taste), and stir. Garnish with an apple slice and a lime wedge, and serve.

name: Hot African Punch
ingredients: 2 bottles Jamaican dark rum|4 bottles brandy|1 gallon coffee|4 lb sugar
instructions: Place 4 lbs of sugar in a large pan. Pour 4 bottles of brandy and ^^2 bottles of Jamaican rum over sugar, stir until sugar dissolves. Set the liquid on fire, (may be difficult to light), and stir with a long metal spoon. Add 1 gallon of coffee.

name: S.O.B.
ingredients: 1/2 oz Cognac|1/2 oz Cointreau|Lemon slice|Sugar
instructions: Drink this just like a shot of tequila. Mix the cognac and cointreau together in the shot glass. Lick between your thumb and forefinger and sprinkle sugar on it. Then lick the sugar, drink the shot, and suck on the lemon wedge when you're done.

name: Ship of Fools
ingredients: 1 oz Sailor Jerry(R) spiced navy rum|1 oz Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|1 oz Admiral Nelson's(R) coconut rum|1 oz Cabana Boy(R) pineapple coconut rum|4 oz pineapple juice|2 ozcrushed pineapples|2 oz coconut milk
instructions: Originally served in Madison, Wisconsin by Christopher Walters. Invented as a rum-based variation to The Three Wise Men whiskey blend.Blend all ingredients together at high speed until slightly foamy. Serve in a collins glass over crushed ice.

name: Black Napkin
ingredients: 1 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|1 oz Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|1 splash grenadine syrup|top with Royal Crown(R) cola
instructions: Pour the Southern Comfort peach liqueur into a highball glass half-filled with ice cubes. Add grenadine and Captain Morgan spiced rum. Top with a healthy dose of Royal Crown cola. Serve unstirred topped with a lime wedge and maraschino cherry.
shopping: Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|grenadine syrup|Royal Crown(R) cola

name: Irish Dream
ingredients: 1/2 oz hazelnut liqueur|1/2 oz Irish cream|3/4 oz brown creme de cacao|4 oz vanilla ice cream|1 1/2 oz whipped cream
instructions: Combine the hazelnut liqueur, irish cream, brown creme de cacao and vanilla ice cream in a blender with one cup of crushed ice. Pour into a frosted pilsner glass. Top with whipped cream. Garnish with chocolate sprinkles or shavings, and serve.
shopping: hazelnut liqueur|Irish cream|brown creme de cacao|vanilla ice cream|whipped cream

name: Celeste Sunrise
ingredients: 1 oz Frangelico(R) hazelnut liqueur|1 oz strawberry liqueur|1 oz advocaat liqueur|2 oz cream|lemonade
instructions: Pour the Frangelico hazelnut liqueur, strawberry liqueur, advocaat and cream into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with lemonade until frothy. Garnish with a strawberry, and serve.

name: Breeze of Saronno
ingredients: 1 oz Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur|3/4 oz creme de menthe|1/4 oz vodka|1 splash creme de cacao
instructions: Pour the Amaretto di Saronno, creme de menthe, vodka and creme de cacao into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and pour into a chilled rocks or old-fashioned glass. Garnish with mint leaves and almond powder, and serve.
shopping: Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur|creme de menthe|vodka|creme de cacao

name: The Perfect Old-Fashioned
ingredients: 2 oz bourbon whiskey|1-3 dash bitter|1 splash soda water|1  sugar|maraschino cherries
instructions: Okay, so there are probably more variations on the Old-Fashioned than there are people who have ever actually ordered one. This is what I consider to be a perfect Old-Fashioned. Remember not to muddle the cherries like so many recipes call for
shopping: and forget about using orange slices.In an empty rocks glass

name: Pimp Juice
ingredients: 3 oz Smirnoff(R) Green Apple Twist vodka|6 oz 7-Up(R) cherry soda
instructions: Pimp Juice was inspired by the song of the same name. It is popular at Kappa Sigma Fraternity in San Luis Obispo, California, near where a Mr David McAninch first created it.Pour ingredients over a few ice cubes in a highball glass, and serve.
shopping: Smirnoff(R) Green Apple Twist vodka|7-Up(R) cherry soda

name: Greenbrier Creek
ingredients: 2 oz gin|4 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|2 ozmelted chocolate
instructions: Pour the Kahlua coffee liqueur into a frosted (note: important) brandy snifter glass. Add the gin, and mix well. Drizzle the hot melted chocolate over the drink, being sure to let it slightly drip onto the side of the glass. Do not mix. Serve.

name: Ace Ventura
ingredients: 1/4 oz vodka|1/4 oz tequila|1/4 oz rum|4 1/2 oz Sprite(R) soda|1 dash red sambuca|1 dash blue sambuca|1 dash Galliano(R) green sambuca|1 dash black sambuca|1 dash white sambuca|1 dash gold sambuca|1 dash sambuca
instructions: Take a large chilled cocktail glass and fill it 1/4 full with ice, and top to 3/4 full with sprite. Add the vodka, rum and tequila. Fill the glass with the flavored sambucas in layers. Garnish with an umbrella and serve with a bendable straw.
shopping: vodka|tequila|rum|Sprite(R) soda|red sambuca|blue sambuca|Galliano(R) green sambuca|black sambuca|white sambuca|gold sambuca|sambuca

name: Purple Squirrel
ingredients: 1 oz light rum|1 oz coconut rum|1 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|1 oz grenadine syrup|1 ozfreshly squeezed lime juice|1 oz club soda
instructions: Mix everything but club soda and shake well in a tumbler. Add the club soda and pour over ice in cocktail glass. Garnish with a slice of lime with an almond embedded in it. Additional ingredients for variations: creme de almond, coconut milk.
shopping: light rum|coconut rum|Blue Curacao liqueur|grenadine syrup|lime juice|club soda

name: My Busted Cherry
ingredients: Jar of Maraschino cherry|1 1/2 oz Rum (Bacardi)|Chocolate syrup (Hershey's)|2 scoops Vanilla ice-cream|1/4 cup Milk
instructions: Drain cherry juice out of jar and fill with rum. Let set overnight in refridgerator. -- In blender mix six (your choice) cherries, ice cream, milk, rum, and chocolate syrup (to taste). Blend until smooth. Add more milk or ice cream as needed.

name: Pineapple Cooler
ingredients: 2 oz White wine|2 oz Pineapple juice|Carbonated water|1/2 tsp Powdered sugar|1 Orange spiral|1 twist of Lemon peel
instructions: Put white wine, pineapple juice, powdered sugar, and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass and stir. Add ice cubes, fill with carbonated water, and stir again. Add the lemon peel and the orange spiral so the end dangles over rim of glass.
shopping: White wine|Pineapple juice|Carbonated water|Powdered sugar|Orange spiral|Lemon peel

name: Grapes of Wrath
ingredients: 3 oz Blue Curacao|1 oz Vodka|2 oz Cranberry juice|2 oz Grape juice|1 oz Coca-Cola|1 splash of Pineapple juice
instructions: Fill collins glass with ice. Pour blue curacao and vodka into glass. Fill 3/4 of the glass with 1/2 cranberry juice and 1/2 grape juice. Then fill the rest of the glass with coke. Add a splash of pineapple at the top and then shake thourghly.

name: Alien Urine
ingredients: 1/2 oz Midori melon liqueur|1/2 oz Peach schnapps|1 oz Coconut rum|1 part Sweet and sour|1 part Orange juice
instructions: This drink is ideally made in a 16 ounce glass, but can also be made in a Collins glass. The drink is served on the rocks. Add the Midori, Malibo, and Schnaps. Add juices. Shake in a tin. Garnish with either two cherries or with a kiwi wheel.
shopping: Midori melon liqueur|Peach schnapps|Coconut rum|Sweet and sour|Orange juice

name: Bird of Paradise Cooler
ingredients: 2 oz gin|1 ozfresh lemon juice|1 tsp grenadine syrup|1 tsp superfine sugar|1  egg|soda water
instructions: Pour the gin, lemon juice, grenadine, superfine sugar and egg white into a cocktail shaker half-filled with cracked ice. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Fill with soda/sparkling water. Stir well, and serve.

name: Salty Dog #2
ingredients: 3 oz fresh Grapefruit juice|4 oz Vodka|pinch Powdered sugar (caster sugar)|4-6 Ice cubes
instructions: Combine the grapefruit juice, vidka sugar and 4 or 5 ice cubes in a mixing glass, and stir gently with a bar spoon to dissolve the sugar and combine the ingredients. Strain into a chilled wineglass. Add 1 ice cube to the wineglass if desired.

name: Banana Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Light rum|1 tblsp Triple sec|1 Banana|1 1/2 oz Lime juice|1 tsp Sugar|1 Cherry
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except for the cherry) with 1 cup crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for five seconds, then blend at a high speed until firm. Pour contents into a champagne flute, top with the cherry, and serve.

name: Blue MotherFucker
ingredients: 3 oz Absolut(R) Citron vodka|3 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|3 oz sweet and sour mix
instructions: There's a Purple Motherfucker, Green Motherfucker and Yellow Motherfucker. Now a Blue Motherfucker has been spotted in Athens, Georgia and Orlando, Florida. Here's how it goes.Shake ingredients, strain over ice in a highball glass, and serve.
shopping: Absolut(R) Citron vodka|Blue Curacao liqueur|sweet and sour mix

name: Rainbow Julep
ingredients: 2 fresh mint|1/2 oz Marie Brizard(R) Apry apricot brandy|2 oz bourbon whiskey
instructions: Muddle one of the mint sprigs with apricot brandy in the bottom of a mixing glass. Add bourbon and strain into a highball glass filled with crushed ice. Swirl with a barspoon until the outer glass frosts. Garnish with a mint sprig, and serve.
shopping: mint|Marie Brizard(R) Apry apricot brandy|bourbon whiskey

name: 3 for a Dollar Special
ingredients: 8 oz vodka|4 oz triple sec|3  mangos|2  limes|3/4 cup water|1/2 cup sugar
instructions: Boil the sugar and water in a bowl. Chill for 20 minutes.^^^^Add the chopped mangos, along vodka, triple sec and two limes to a blender with 40 ice cubes. Blend, add the water and sugar mixture, and blend again. Serve in your glass of choice.

name: Anna's Banana
ingredients: 2 oz vodka|1 ozfresh lime juice|1 tsp honey|1/2  banana
instructions: Peel and slice the banana; add to blender. Add vodka, lime juice and honey (or substitute almond syrup). Add cracked ice, and blend on medium speed for 15 seconds. Pour into a chilled white wine glass, garnish with a slice of lime, and serve.

name: Dirty Rollie Fingers
ingredients: 1 oz vodka|1 oz pickle brine|1 dash Tabasco(R) sauce
instructions: Dirty Rollie Fingers was invented at the Douglass House Saloon in Houghton, MichiganAdd the vodka and pickle brine (preferably from a pickled egg jar) to a shot glass. Add Tabasco sauce, and garnish with an optional slice of pickled jalapeno.

name: Party Boy

instructions: Pour the dark rum, grenadine, lime juice and sugar into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass almost filled with crushed ice. Top with cherry brandy. Garnish with slice of lime, and serve.

instructions: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice and add gin. Fill with carbonated water and stir. Add the lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end of the orange spiral dangles over rim of glass.

name: Finger Me Good

shopping: Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|Mountain Dew(R) citrus soda

name: Schnapp Bomb

instructions: Pour a whole bottle of Archers peach schnapps into a medium sized saucepan. Heat until hot, but do not boil. Gradually add the sugar until saturation point (about 1 - 1.5 Kgs). Serve in shot glasses and knock back in one go whilst still hot.

name: Volga Boatman

instructions: Combine the orange juice, vodka and kirsch in a mixing glass and add the ice cubes. Place a shaker on top of the glass and, grasping them firmly together with both hands, shake vigorously. Remove the shaker and strain into a cocktail glass.

name: Green Monster Party Punch
ingredients: 3 packages Lime Kool-Aid|1 bottle Vodka|1 bottle Fruit juice (any)|20-25 pieces Fruit, mixed|1 gal Sherbet (any flavor)
instructions: Mix all ingredients(in any order) in a large tub, which can hold several gallons. Stir so that the Sherbert is completely dissolved. With the exception of the kool-aid and sherbert, as much or little of the other ingredients may be used.

name: Refresher
ingredients: 1 oz Aftershock(R) Cool Citrus mint schnapps|5 oz WKD(R) Original Vodka Blue|5 oz cider|5 oz Red Bull(R) energy drink
instructions: The Refresher is simply named after the childrens sweets that fizz on your tongue with what can only be described as a fresh (blue?) taste.  This cocktail mimics that feeling but with an added smack of alcohol. Origin may be a bar in Kos
shopping: Greece where an English barman said he had invented it over the summer of 06. Also you can tweek the ingredients a little

name: Lonely Night
ingredients: 3/4 oz coffee liqueur|1 1/4 oz Irish cream|1 1/4 oz hazelnut liqueur|1 scoop vanilla ice cream|1/2 oz whipped cream
instructions: Add the coffee liqueur, irish cream, hazelnut liqueur and vanilla ice cream to a blender with one cup of crushed ice. Blend until smooth. Pour into a parfait glass, and top with whipped cream. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings, and serve.
shopping: coffee liqueur|Irish cream|hazelnut liqueur|vanilla ice cream|whipped cream

name: Lover's Kiss
ingredients: 1/2 oz amaretto almond liqueur|1/2 oz cherry brandy|1/2 oz brown creme de cacao|1 oz cream|1/2 oz whipped cream
instructions: Pour the amaretto, cherry brandy, brown creme de cacao and cream into a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake well, and strain into a parfait glass. Top with whipped cream. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings and garnish with a maraschino cherry.
shopping: amaretto almond liqueur|cherry brandy|brown creme de cacao|cream|whipped cream

name: Delta Cocktail
ingredients: 2 oz Scotch whisky|1/2 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|1/2 ozfresh lime juice|1 tsp superfine sugar
instructions: Pour the scotch whisky, Southern Comfort, lime juice and sugar into a cocktail shaker half-filled with cracked ice. Shake well, and strain into an old-fashioned glass. Garnish with a slice of orange and a fresh slice of peach, and serve.
shopping: Scotch whisky|Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|lime juice|superfine sugar

name: Tartan Swizzle
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Lime juice|1 tsp superfine Sugar|2 oz Scotch|1 dash Bitters|crushed Ice|3 oz Club soda
instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine lime juice, sugar, Scotch, and bitters. Shake well. Almost fill a collins glass with crushed ice. Stir until glass is frosted. Strain mixture in shaker into the glass and add the club soda.

name: Original Singapore Sling
ingredients: 2 oz gin|1 oz cherry brandy|1 oz lime juice|1/4 tsp benedictine herbal liqueur|1/4 tsp brandy
instructions: Combine the gin, cherry brandy and lime juice in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Drop the benedictine and brandy into the centre of the drink, and serve.

name: Scotch Old-Fashioned
ingredients: 3 dashes Bitters|3 oz Scotch|1 tsp Water|1 Sugar cube|1 Orange slice|1 Maraschino cherry
instructions: In an old-fashioned glass, muddle the bitters and water into the sugar cube, using the back of a teaspoon. Almost fill the glass with ice cubes and add the scotch. Garnish with the orange slice and the cherry. Serve with a swizzle stick.

name: Smooth Sailin'
ingredients: 32 oz Cranberry juice cocktail|28 oz Ginger ale|12 oz Lemonade|1-1/2 cup Bourbon
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a medium-sized bowl. Freeze in small airtight containers. To serve, remove from freezer and let thaw about 10 minutes. Scrape or scoop into stemmed glasses. Serve with straws, if desired. Makes 14 six-ounce drinks.

name: Amaretto Chi-City
ingredients: 4 oz Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur|4 oz E&J(R) brandy|5 oz sweet and sour mix
instructions: Mix Amaretto di Saronno in equal parts with E&J or if u choose a bit more E&J. Mix to your taste with sweet and sour mix in a shaker. Add ice and shake well. Pour into your favorite glass and watch for the hook - its real slow and tasty.
shopping: Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur|E&J(R) brandy|sweet and sour mix

name: Alaena
ingredients: 1/3  pineapple juice|1/3  cranberry juice|1/3  soda water|1 shot vodka
instructions: Named after Alaena Jac (Sydney, New South Whales, Australia) after tasting a Rebecca and noting it would be better with vodka.  This is a surprisingly refreshing and delicious drinkEach ingredient should be poured in (no particular order
shopping: though bar tenders will typically add the vodka shot last).  And the drink should only be stirred - never shaken - to help maintain the soda water's fizz.

name: Polish Flameberry
ingredients: 1 oz raspberry syrup|1 oz Smirnoff(R) vodka|1 dash Tabasco(R) sauce
instructions: Layer the syrup first with vodka on the top then a few drops of tabasco to taste, for a variation use cherry syrup. Be warned too much tabasco will over power the flavour of the syrup making it taste foul, don't exceed roughly 2-3 drops.

name: Southern Comfort and Lime
ingredients: 4 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|2 oz lime juice
instructions: Mix 4oz. Southern Comfort and 2 oz. Lime juice in a shaker half filled with ice.  Shake until the outside surface of shaker is cool to the touch.  Serve on the rocks or neat in an old fashioned glass.  Garnish with lemon wedge and enjoy!

name: UV Bombpop
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 oz UV(R) blue raspberry vodka|5 oz lemonade
instructions: This is a simple drink and a crowd pleaser. Add UV Blueberry Vodka with or without rocks. Top off with Lemonade (Tropicana or the brand of your choice) to taste. Tastes just like a bombpop popsicle ... This will drive the ladies crazy :)

name: Stabilizer
ingredients: 3/4 oz Bacardi 151 proof rum|3/4 oz Rumple Minze
instructions: Chill the Rumple Minze until VERY cold. Then pour over the 151 in a shot glass. They will not layer, so don't try it. Then drink the shot quickly...don't waste time smelling the shot or sipping it...just drink it. The sit back and enjoy!

name: Boston Burn-out
ingredients: 1 shot Root beer schnapps (or liquer)|1 shot Amaretto|1 shot Butterscotch schnapps (or liquer)|1 shot Bacardi 151 proof rum|Top off with 4 shots Irish cream (Bailey's)|4 to 6 drops Tabasco sauce (Tobasco)
instructions: In a LARGE shot glass (or small juice glass), add Rootbeer Schnapps, Amaretto, Butterscotch Schnapps and Bacardi 151 dark. Top off with Bailey's Irish Cream. Add 4 to 6 drops (or more for the daring) of Tabasco on top. Slam, do not sip!
shopping: Root beer schnapps|Amaretto|Butterscotch schnapps|151 proof rum|Irish cream|Tabasco sauce

name: Red Sweater
ingredients: 1 part vodka|1 part Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|1 part peach schnapps|1 part triple sec|1/2 part grenadine syrup|1 part amaretto almond liqueur|1 part cranberry juice|1 part orange juice
instructions: Mix Vodka, Southern Comfort, Peach Snapps, Triple Sec, Amaretto, Cranberry Juice and Orange Juice together over ice. Add a teaspoon of so of the grenandine. You want it to be a ruby red color. Shake well, pour in a shot glass and enjoy!
shopping: vodka|Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|peach schnapps|triple sec|grenadine syrup|amaretto almond liqueur|cranberry juice|orange juice

name: Divine
ingredients: 1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|1/2 oz peach schnapps|3/4 oz Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|3 oz Sierra Mist(R) soda|3 oz Squirt(R) citrus soda
instructions: Pour the blue curacao, peach schynapps and Captain Morgan spiced rum into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass. Add the Sierra Mist and Squirt (both chilled), stir lightly and serve.
shopping: Blue Curacao liqueur|peach schnapps|Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|Sierra Mist(R) soda|Squirt(R) citrus soda

name: Cassis Screwdriver
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Vodka|1 1/2 oz Orange juice|1/2 oz Creme de Cassis|1 splash Lemon juice or lime juice|1 splash Grenadine|Ice|1 wedge Lemon or lime
instructions: Pour vodka, orange juice, and lemon/lime juice into a shaker half-filled with ice. Shake. Strain into a collins glass with several ice cubes. Add a splash of creme de cassis and of grenadine. Garnish with a lemon/lime wedge and a straw.

name: Lei Lani
ingredients: 1 1/4 oz dark rum|1/2 oz lemon juice|1/2 oz pineapple juice|1/2 oz papaya juice|1 oz orange juice|1 dash grenadine syrup|2 oz soda water
instructions: Pour the rum, lemon juice, pineapple juice, papaya juice and orange juice into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Add a dash of grenadine, and stir well. Top with soda water. Garnish with a fruit flag or pineapple wedge, and serve.
shopping: dark rum|lemon juice|pineapple juice|papaya juice|orange juice|grenadine syrup|soda water

name: Jamaican Banana
ingredients: 1/2 oz Light rum|1/2 oz white Creme de Cacao|1/2 oz Creme de Banane|2 scoops Vanilla ice-cream|1 oz Half-and-half|1 Banana in slices
instructions: Blend all ingredients (except sliced banana) in an electric blender at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into a large brandy snifter and add sliced banana. Sprinkle lightly with nutmeg, top with a whole strawberry, and serve.
shopping: Light rum|Creme de Cacao|Creme de Banane|Vanilla ice-cream|Half-and-half|Banana

name: Pousse Cafe Standish
ingredients: 1/2 oz grenadine syrup|1/2 oz white creme de menthe|1/2 oz Galliano(R) herbal liqueur|1/2 oz Kummel(R) caraway liqueur|1/2 oz brandy
instructions: Pour the grenadine into a pousse-cafe glass. Carefully float the white creme de menthe on top by pouring slowly over the back of a teaspoon. Do the same with the galliano, and then again with the kummel, and then lastly with the brandy.
shopping: grenadine syrup|white creme de menthe|Galliano(R) herbal liqueur|Kummel(R) caraway liqueur|brandy

name: Zio Joe's Traffic Lights
ingredients: 2/3 shot Coca Buton(R) herbal liqueur|1/3 shot Alcohol-95(R) grain alcohol|1 shot limoncello lemon liqueur|1 shot strawberry vodka
instructions: As seen in Zio Joe's Bar in province of Varese, Italy.Traffic Lights is made up of 3 single shots:^^^^The first one, green, is a Zio Joe's Pallottola (Bullet). It is made up filling the shot glass with 2/3 Coca Buton and 1/3 95? Alcohol

name: Datsun Cocktail

instructions: Add the Kahlua coffee liqueur, Tia Maria coffee liqueur, Cointreau and milk to a blender. Blend for 5 seconds, and pour into a highball glass almost filled with ice. Layer whipped cream on top, garnish with a half-strawberry, and serve.
shopping: Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|Tia Maria(R) coffee liqueur|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|milk|whipped cream

name: Deceased Rabbit

instructions: Pour the vodka and liqueurs in the above order into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Stir the ingrediens and fill up with soda water and sprite. Squeeze a lime wedge over (optional but make sure to use one as garnish), and serve.
shopping: vanilla vodka|vodka|Midori(R) melon liqueur|Sourz(R) apple liqueur|soda water|Sprite(R) soda

ingredients: 1 3/4 oz white rum|1 oz coconut rum|1/2 oz lime juice|3/4 oz sugar syrup|3/4 oz coconut cream|1 tsp whipping cream|2 tsp dark rum
instructions: Rim glass with lime and grated coconut. Shake all ingredients (except dark rum) and strain into a wine goblet filled with crushed ice. Garnish with a slice of lime, and sprinkle dark rum on top using a barspoon. Serve with short straws.
shopping: white rum|coconut rum|lime juice|sugar syrup|coconut cream|whipping cream|dark rum

instructions: This recipe for a variation of Green Lantern tastes like a creamy caramel apple.Pour Captain Morgan spiced rum and Southern Comfort peach liqueur into a cocktail glass. Add crushed ice, fill with Jone's green apple soda, stir and serve.

instructions: Pour the vodka, Midori melon liqueur, Crown Royal whisky and triple sec into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Add sweet and sour mix to taste. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass, garnish with a cherry flag, and serve.
shopping: vodka|Midori(R) melon liqueur|Crown Royal(R) Canadian whisky|triple sec|sweet and sour mix

name: Banana Jacuzzi Shake
ingredients: 3 - 4 oz Bacardi(R) Coco rum|5 cups milk|3  bananas|1/2 gallon vanilla ice cream|2 tsp coconut extract|6  ice cubes
instructions: Add ice cubes and milk to a blender. Stir until ice cubes melt. Chop if there is a chopping setting. Blend for 20 seconds. Add ice cream. Blend for 30 seconds. Add rum and coconut extract, blend for 45 seconds. Serve in chilled glasses.
shopping: Bacardi(R) Coco rum|milk|bananas|vanilla ice cream|coconut extract|ice cubes

name: Hot Apple Pie with Sparks
ingredients: 1/2 oz Irish cream|1/2 oz Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps|1 splash Bacardi(R) 151 rum|2 - 3 pinches cinnamon
instructions: Layer the Irish cream and Goldschlager cinnamon schnapps in a shot glass. Very gently, pour the Bacardi 151 on top. Carefully ignite the 151. Throw small handfuls of cinnamon powder on top 2 - 3 times to make sparks. Blow out and serve.

name: USS Enterprise

instructions: Drink this when you want to go boldly where no man has gone before. Invented by a bored Trekkie. Popular at Star Trek conventions.Pour the Kirk (Captain Morgan) into shot glass. Add Scotty (Scotch) followed by Chekov (Vodka), and serve.
shopping: Captain Morgan(R) Silver spiced rum|Johnnie Walker(R) Scotch whisky|Smirnoff(R) vodka

name: Cum in Your Panties

instructions: Pour the vodka, peach schnapps, Chambord raspberry liqueur and cream into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake vigorously. Strain into a cocktail glass. Top with whipped cream, garnish with a maraschino cherry, and serve.

name: Chocolate Cappuccino

instructions: Pour Carolan's irish cream, creme de cacao, Kahlua coffee liqueur and milk into a cocktail shaker half-filled with cracked ice. Shake well, until frothy. Strain into a cocktail/martini glass, garnish with a chocolate ovation, and serve.
shopping: Carolans(R) Irish cream|white creme de cacao|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|milk

instructions: Pour the coconut liqueur, cranberry juice and pineapple juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a collins glass filled with ice cubes. Fill with soda, garnish with a twist of lime, and serve.

name: Old Fashioned (Sweet) #2
ingredients: 1 oz brandy|1 tsp sugar|5 drops bitters|2 oz 7-Up(R) soda|1 splash grenadine syrup
instructions: Add drops of bitters to bottom of glass and stir in sugar. Once bitters and sugar are combined, add ice and pour in brandy. Top off with 7-up/Sprite and add a splash of grenadine. Serve with cherry/orange slice. Also works with whiskey.

name: Floyd Collins

name: Frozen Orange Dream

instructions: In blender place about 8 ice cubes, 2 oz. Grand Marnier,and about 1/4 cup vanilla ice cream. Blend until smooth. Add a drop or two of orange food coloring for stronger color. Pour into a Hurricane glass and garnish with an orange slice.
shopping: Grand Marnier(R) orange liqueur|ice cubes|vanilla ice cream

name: Obama Mama

instructions: 2008 presidential election has inspired me.  Popularity, don't know yet,  guess it depends on your vote!!!^^^^Invented by Pam JensenShake  rums and Baileys in iced shaker, pour into politically correct glass,  and top with whipped cream

name: Panama City Gin 'n' Juice

instructions: Fill a collins glass 3/4 full with ice. Slowly add the lime juice , then bulid with gin. Slowly fill with 7-Up leaving green and clear layers intact until just before drinking. Garnish with a twist of lime on a bamboo skewer, and serve.

name: Brush Fire

instructions: Pour 1/3 ounce tabasco sauce into a one ounce shot glass. Fill the rest of the shot glass with either HOT 100 or if you prefer you can use a regular cinnamon schnapps. Drink immediately after making. This drink will lose flavor quickly.

name: Flaming Ferrari

instructions: Pour the rums into an old-fashioned glass. Seperately, pour the blue curacao into a double-shot glass. Ignite the rum mixture (use extreme caution) and suck with a straw; at the same time pour the blue curacao into the glass and finish.

name: Port Wine Sangaree

instructions: Dissolve the sugar in the water and port in the bottom of a highball glass. Almost fill the glass with crushed ice; add the soda. Float the brandy on top, and garnish with a lemon twist. Dust with nutmeg, then with cinnamon, and serve.

name: Michelle's Indigo

shopping: gin|Blue Curacao liqueur|triple sec|lime juice|7-Up(R) soda|lime|sugar

ingredients: 1/2 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1/2 oz coconut vodka|1/8 oz Nestle(R) chocolate syrup
instructions: Pour the vodka into a shot glass, and add the Bailey's slowly so it sits on top of the vodka and it creates a layer. Leave just a little room at the top and squeeze a little bit of the chocolate so it runs through the drink, serve.
shopping: Bailey's(R) Irish cream|coconut vodka|Nestle(R) chocolate syrup

name: Beach Water
ingredients: 6 oz Hpnotiq(R) liqueur|4 1/2 oz Cruzan(R) coconut rum|3 oz Sprite(R) soda
instructions: Pour the coconut rum into a collins glass half-filled with ice. Add Hpnotiq until a very pretty light blue (like tropical beach water), then add some sprite for a little fizz and some taste. Mix and enjoy the beach wherever you go.

name: Lighthouse
ingredients: 1/3 oz Kahlua|1/3 oz Bailey's irish cream|1/3 oz 151 proof rum
instructions: Pour Kahlua in shot glass then with a spoon slowly pour Irish Cream into the shot glass on top of the Kahlua then pour the 151 Rum with the Spoon slowly on top of the Irish Cream then light on fire.. Blow out Flame Before Drinking!

name: Boye Sparkle
ingredients: 3 1/2 oz Champagne|1/2 oz strawberry liqueur|1 oz mango juice
instructions: One for the occasion. Boye Sparkle was created by Ronald Penaflor and Gloria Gahum of the philippines.Pour champagne into a champagne flute. Add strawberry liqueur and mango juice, garnish with a sugar-dipped strawberry, and serve.

name: Hot and Dirty Martini
ingredients: 3 oz pepper vodka|1/2 oz dry vermouth|1 tsp olive juice
instructions: Pour the pepper vodka, dry vermouth and olive brine into a cocktail shaker half-filled with cracked ice. Shake well, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with an olive stuffed with a pickled jalapeno pepper, and serve.

name: Helluva Hurricane
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Dark rum (Meyer's)|1 1/2 oz Light rum (Bacardi)|2 oz Orange juice|2 oz Pineapple juice|1 1/2 tsp Grenadine|1/2 tsp Sugar|1 oz Bacardi 151 proof rum|2 Cherries|1 chunk Pineapple|1 cube Sugar
instructions: Pour dark rum, light rum, juices, and grenadine over ice into a pilsner/parfait glass. Add the half spoon of sugar, stir slightly, and top with high octane 151 rum and cherries/pineapple. Add the optional sugar cube & light it up!
shopping: Dark rum|Light rum|Orange juice|Pineapple juice|Grenadine|Sugar|151 proof rum|Cherries|Pineapple|Sugar

name: Fruity as Fuck

instructions: Pour the Bacardi Raz and Stolichnaya raspberry vodka (Stoli Razberi) followed by the orange juice and Red Bull into a highball glass. Splash with cranberry juice. Garnish with a slice of orange, with a cherry on a pick, and serve.
shopping: Bacardi(R) Razz rum|Stoli(R) Razberi vodka|Red Bull(R) energy drink|orange juice|cranberry juice

name: Jubilee

shopping: tequila|gin|vodka|Blue Curacao liqueur|lemon juice|superfine sugar|club soda

name: Midori Margarita
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Tequila|1/2 oz Triple sec or other orange liqueur|1 oz fresh Lime juice|1/2 oz Midori melon liqueur|Salt
instructions: Moisten rim of cocktail glass with lime juice and dip in salt. Shake ingredients together, and pour into glass filled with crushed ice. Option: Mix above ingredients with one cup of ice in blender for a smooth, granita type drink.

name: Cool Carlos
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz dark rum|2 oz cranberry juice|2 oz pineapple juice|1 oz orange juice|1 splash sweet and sour mix
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except curacao) in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well. Pour into a collins glass and float curacao on top. Garnish with pineapple and orange slices and a maraschino cherry, and serve.
shopping: dark rum|cranberry juice|pineapple juice|orange juice|sweet and sour mix

name: A Night In Old Mandalay
ingredients: 1 oz Light rum|1 oz Anejo rum|1 oz Orange juice|1/2 oz Lemon juice|3 oz Ginger ale|1 twist of Lemon peel
instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the light rum, anejo rum, orange juice, and lemon juice. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Top with the ginger ale. Garnish with the lemon twist.
shopping: Light rum|Anejo rum|Orange juice|Lemon juice|Ginger ale|Lemon peel

name: Frozen Fruit Daiquiri
ingredients: 2 oz white rum|2 - 3 dashes dark rum|2 - 3 dashes syrup|1/2 tsp powdered sugar|fruit|3/4 oz lime juice
instructions: Add pieces of a chosen fruit, syrup (of that chosen fruit), rums, sugar, lime juice and crushed ice to a blender, and blend. Pour into a cocktail glass, and serve.^^^^Popular fruits to choose; bananas, pineapples and strawberries.

name: Damn Good Lemonade
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz vodka|1 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1/2 oz Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|6 oz sweet and sour mix
instructions: Add ice to the hurricane glass. Add the liquor and fill almost to the top with sweet and sour, then add a splash of sprite. Mix by pouring the drink into a mixing glass then back into the hurricane glass. Add a lemon as a garnish.
shopping: vodka|Malibu(R) coconut rum|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|sweet and sour mix

name: Scotch Fix
