instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the sugar, lemon juice, and water. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass almost filled with crushed ice. Add the Scotch. Stir well and garnish with the cherry and the lemon slice.

name: Sexy Martini
ingredients: 2 oz vodka|1 oz Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|1 oz Hpnotiq(R) liqueur|1 splash Brut(R) Champagne
instructions: Pour 2 shots of vodka, preferrably Grey Goose or Belvedere,  then add 1 shot of chambord, then add 1 shot of hypnotiq and shake, don't stir.  Once shaken pour into a cocktail glass and pour a splash of champagne, preferrably brut.

name: Poor Man's Pina Colada
ingredients: 1 - 2 oz coconut rum|8 - 10 oz pineapple juice|1 oz Myer's(R) dark rum|1 cup crushed ice
instructions: Put crushed ice in glass.  Pour 1-2 oz of Parrot Bay or Malibu Coconut Rum over ice - adjust to taste.  Fill glass 3/4 full with pineapple juice.  Pour 1 oz of Meyers Dark Rum on top as a floater.  It will take you to the islands!
shopping: coconut rum|pineapple juice|Myer's(R) dark rum|crushed ice

name: Escalator Martini
ingredients: 2 shots pear schnapps|1 shot Zubrowka(R) vodka|4 pressed apple juice|dash sugar syrup
instructions: This was created by Kevin Connelly in 2002. The name comes from Cockney rhyming slang - apples and pears = stairs. Originally made using Vilmos korte palinka (Hungarian pear schnapps) but usually made with Poire William eau de vie

name: Foxy Shot
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Smirnoff(R) Green Apple Twist vodka|1 splash Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur
instructions: Pour the Smirnoff Green Apple Twist vodka into a shaker half-filled with crushed ice. Shake well. and pour into a 2-oz shot glass. Splash some Amaretto Di Saronno into the shot glass, just enough to swirl into the shot, and serve.
shopping: Smirnoff(R) Green Apple Twist vodka|Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur

name: Jolly Joker
ingredients: 1 original flavor jolly rancher candy|1 shot Smirnoff(R) vodka
instructions: Pour vodka into a shot glass, take any original flavor jolly rancher(watermelon, lemon, green-apple, cherry, grape, orange) and plop into shot glass...let sit for one half hour(to ferment) *do not refridgerate*! Serve at room temp

name: Desi
ingredients: 1/2 oz vodka|1 tsp mango juice|1/2 oz whipped cream
instructions: Desi is a modern New York drink invented by Jithin Johnson. It's popular in all bars in New York.Pour vodka and mango juice over ice in a shaker. Shake until frozen, and strain into a shot glass. Top with whipped cream, and serve.

name: Slugger's Delight
ingredients: 1 shot 151 proof rum|12 oz Rock and rye
instructions: Pour the Rock & Rye into a glass with ice. While the Rock & Rye is still fizzing, quickly add the 151 proof rum. Stir thouroughly before drinking. (Heavy concentrations of 151 have been known to cause a few sore throats.) Enjoy!!!

name: Blue Thrill
ingredients: 1 shot Blue Curacao|1 shot Lemon juice
instructions: Fill one shot glass with the Blue Curacao. Fill another shot glass with the lemon juice, and serve. To drink, first put lemon shot in mouth, then put curacao shot in mouth, swish around then swallow. Remember, yellow before blue!!

name: Pirates Pleasure

shopping: Captain Morgan(R) Private Stock dark rum|Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|Captain Morgan(R) Parrot Bay coconut rum|pineapple|limes

name: Lakeside Lemonade

shopping: vodka|Pisang Ambon(R) liqueur|passion-fruit liqueur|vanilla ice cream|pineapple juice

name: Abortion

instructions: Place all four ingredients and ice into a shaker and shake like crazy!! Strain into shot glasses. OR..... Place the first three ingredients into a shaker, shake. Pour into a glass of your choice, top with ice and cranberry juice.

name: Ovaltini

name: African Tinnie

instructions: The African Tinnie has unknown origins, but was first served to the contributor in a club in Auckland NZ just over 10 yrs ago. It has a taste like a cola popsicle/ice block.Layer ingredients in order into a shot glass, and serve.

name: Gold Bomb

name: B-52 #6

instructions: First add the Amaretto, then the Bailey's, and then carefully the Rum. Put the shot on fire and drink it with a straw, or you have another choice: When the shot is on fire you slap it to extinguish the fire and then you drink it.

name: Bacardi Gold & Cola
ingredients: 4 cl Gold rum (Bacardi)|16 cl Coca-Cola|1 Lemon slice
instructions: Fill a tall glass completely with ice cubes. Mix the ingredients into the glass and serve with a slice of lemon put on the glass. It is a very simple drink, but never the less it is very deliscious - especially in the summertime.

name: Charlie's Angel

instructions: Half fill glass with ice. Pour all ingredients into the beaker of a cocktail shaker apart from the soda. Mix gently. Pour into glass. Take one fresh lime wedge, squeeze and drop in. Add soda to top. Serve with stirrer and straw.
shopping: Mezcal|Grand Marnier|Orange bitters|Orange juice|Grapefruit juice|Ice|Soda water

name: Ken and Kirsten's top shelf Margarita
ingredients: 2 shots Tequila (Sauza)|1 shot Cointreau|1 cup Lemonade (Newman's)|1 splash Grapefruit juice|Juice of 3 wedges Lime|1 handful Salt to coat the rim of the glass
instructions: Mix all ingredients and add ice. Shake well pouring ingredients into a second glass. At this point coat the rim of the first glass with salt. Repour your drink into the salted glass. Add fresh squeezed lime, kick back and enjoy!

name: Choclatini

shopping: Absolut(R) vanilla vodka|Godiva(R) chocolate liqueur|Godiva(R) white chocolate liqueur|whipped cream|maraschino cherry

name: Sweet-tart Lollipop
ingredients: 1/4 shot Raspberry schnapps|1/4 shot Lime vodka|1/4 shot Amaretto|1/4 shot Bacardi Limon|1/4 shot Peach schnapps|Fill glass sweet Lemonade

name: Bloody Tampon

name: Arawak Cup

instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the bourbon, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Add the club soda. Stir and garnish with the cherry and the orange slice.

name: Pamir Peach

name: Fraises Fizz

name: Forest Dream

name: Passion Colada

name: Holiday Cheer

name: Dew-Driver

instructions: Pour the anejo rum, bourbon whiskey, creme de cacao, Drambuie and hot coffee into an Irish coffee cup or glass. Pour the cream carefully over the back of a teaspoon on top of the drink so that it floats, and serve.
shopping: anejo rum|bourbon whiskey|dark creme de cacao|Drambuie(R) Scotch whisky|coffee|heavy cream

name: Mary Poppins
ingredients: 1 oz dark rum|1 oz apricot brandy|2 oz apricot brandy liqueur|2 oz orange juice|1/4 oz pineapple juice|1/4 oz creme de cassis
instructions: Pour the dark rum, apricot brandy and juices into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice. Shake well and pour into a collins glass. Top up with ice and drizzle the creme de cassis and grenadine over the top. Serve.
shopping: dark rum|apricot brandy|apricot brandy liqueur|orange juice|pineapple juice|creme de cassis

name: Bay Horse
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz blended whiskey|1/2 oz Pernod(R) licorice liqueur|1/2 oz dark creme de cacao|1 oz heavy cream|1/4 tspgrated nutmeg
instructions: Pour the whiskey, Pernod, creme de cacao and cream into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with nutmeg, and serve.
shopping: blended whiskey|Pernod(R) licorice liqueur|dark creme de cacao|heavy cream|nutmeg

name: Flaming Angry Dragon
ingredients: 1/2 oz vodka|1/2 oz Hpnotiq(R) liqueur|1/4 oz grenadine syrup|1/4 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1 splash Everclear(R) alcohol
instructions: Mix together the vodka and Hqnotiq liqueur in a double-shot glass. Layer grenadine over the mixture and the Bailey's over that. Add a splash of Everclear over that and light the shot on fire. Extinguish, and serve.
shopping: vodka|Hpnotiq(R) liqueur|grenadine syrup|Bailey's(R) Irish cream|Everclear(R) alcohol

name: Infuriated Plasma
ingredients: 4 oz Dr. McGillicuddy's(R) Fireball Canadian whisky|3 oz Green Chartreuse(R)|473 ml cranberry juice|335 ml cream soda
instructions: Mix the Chartreuse and Fireball in the bottom of the jar. Pour in the cranberry juice and let the cream soda go flat. Pour in the cream soda and mix the whole thing with a wooden spoon and then drink as you please.
shopping: Dr. McGillicuddy's(R) Fireball Canadian whisky|Green Chartreuse(R)|cranberry juice|cream soda

name: Classic Walker
ingredients: 2 oz Johnnie Walker(R) Black Label Scotch whisky|2 oz Perrier(R) soda water|1 ozfresh lime juice|2 slices limes
instructions: Take an old-fashioned glass and place 2 thin slices of lime and ice into it. Add some perrier to extract the essence of the lime. Add Johnnie Walker Black, with lime juice to finish it off. Add a stirrer and serve.
shopping: Johnnie Walker(R) Black Label Scotch whisky|Perrier(R) soda water|lime juice|limes

name: McShake
ingredients: 4 oz Bailey's irish cream|4 oz Milk|2 scoops Cookies n' Cream or Vanilla ice-cream|Chocolate syrup to taste
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in a blender. The chocolate syrup should be added to the liking of the drinker. Next blend until you have achieved desired thickness. Whipped cream and additional toppings are optional.

name: Liquid Caramel
ingredients: 1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|1 oz butterscotch schnapps|3 - 5 ozchilled milk
instructions: Pour the Bailey's irish cream, Kahlua coffee liqueur and butterscotch schnapps into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake quickly, and strain into a highball glass. Top with milk, stir well and serve.
shopping: Bailey's(R) Irish cream|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|butterscotch schnapps|milk

name: Miami Ice
ingredients: 1 oz Vodka|1 oz Rum|1 oz Gin|1 oz Triple sec|1 oz Lemon-lime soda|2 oz Orange juice|1/2 oz Peach schnapps
instructions: Just add EVERYTHING except the Peach Schnapps into the MUG. Lightly stir and then add as much ice (smallest cubes possible) you can fit in. NOTE: Leave just enough room at the top for the 1/4 oz. of Peach Schnapps.
shopping: Vodka| Rum| Gin| Triple sec| Lemon-lime soda| Orange juice| Peach schnapps

name: Canadian Apple
ingredients: 2 oz Canadian whisky|1/2 oz apple brandy|1 1/2 tspfresh lemon juice|1 tsp sugar syrup|1 pinch cinnamon
instructions: Combine the whisky, apple brandy, lemon juice, sugar syrup and cinnamon in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into an old-fashioned glass. Garnish with a slice of lemon, and serve.

name: Nassau Paul
ingredients: 1 oz white rum|1/2 oz Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|2 oz lemon juice|1/2 oz egg|1/2 oz simple syrup
instructions: Combine the white rum, Cointreau, lemon juice, egg white and simple syrup in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a champagne flute. Garnish with a maraschino cherry, and serve.
shopping: white rum|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|lemon juice|egg|simple syrup

name: Diversion
ingredients: 3 oz Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur|2 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|Coca-Cola(R)
instructions: In a shaker with ice, combine 3-parts Amaretto with 2-parts Southern Comfort. Shake and pour in a tall glass to just under 1/2-way. Fill the rest with Pepsi or Coke.^^^^Optional: Garnish with a small wedge of lime.
shopping: Amaretto Di Saronno(R) liqueur|Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|Coca-Cola(R)

name: Paradise Peaches and Cream
ingredients: 4 oz peach vodka|1 oz grenadine syrup|1/2 cup milk|2 cups vanilla ice cream|1  peach
instructions: In blender combine 1 oz. Grenadine, 2 cups vanilla ice cream, 1/2 cup milk, 1 fresh ripe peach, and 4 oz. peach flavored vodka. Blend until smooth. Pour into hurricane glass and garnish with peach wedge and cherry.

name: Wild Jackalope
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Canadian whisky|1/2 oz peppermint schnapps|1 tsp Pernod(R) licorice liqueur
instructions: Pour the whisky, peppermint schnapps and Pernod into a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes. Stir well, and strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a lemon twist, and serve.

name: Chocolate Cloud
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz creme de cacao|1 1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|1/2 oz whipped cream
instructions: Pour the creme de cacao into a cocktail glass. Carefully layer the blue curacao on top by pouring slowly over the back of a teaspoon. Top with whipped cream. Sprinkle chocolate shavings across the cream, and serve.
shopping: creme de cacao|Blue Curacao liqueur|whipped cream

name: Spring Break
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Absolut(R) Kurant vodka|1/2 oz lychee liqueur|3 - 4 oz club soda
instructions: Originated as a tasty pre-concert cocktail.  It is ordered by yelling - Spring Break! or Four More Years! at the bartender/bartendress.  The yelling is akin to that of intoxicated cries from Girls Gone Wild videos.

name: Corey's Oatmeal Cookie
ingredients: 1 oz Bailey's(R) Irish cream|1 oz butterscotch schnapps|1/2 tsp cinnamon
instructions: Pour Bailey's irish cream and butterscotch schnapps into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Add a couple of dashes of cinnamon. Shake well, and strain into a cocktail glass. Dust wth cinnamon, and serve.

name: Plimsoll Cocktail
ingredients: 1 1/4 oz Beefeater(R) gin|1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|1 oz orange juice
instructions: Popular at Plimsoll Club in New Orleans. Created by head bartender Tommy Borne. Shake ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice. Strain into cocktail glass. Garnish with cherry speared to orange slice on glass rim.

name: Coffee Royale
ingredients: 4 ozhot coffee|1 tsp granulated sugar|2 oz brandy|2 oz heavy cream
instructions: Pour the coffee into an Irish coffee cup or glass. Add the sugar, and stir to dissolve. Add the brandy, stir again. Pour the cream over the back of a teaspoon over the top of the drink so that it floats, and serve.

name: Pisco-rita
ingredients: 6 oz frozen Limeade concentrate|6 oz Pisco|3 oz Triple sec|Ice
instructions: Add limeade concentrate, Pisco, and triple sec in blender. Add ice until blender is full. Blend on high speed adding water until blender is full while blending. Serve in margarita glass rimmed with salt if desired.

name: Kilted Black Leprechaun
ingredients: 1 part Bailey's irish cream|1 part Malibu rum|1 part Drambuie
instructions: Layer ingredients in the glass, in the following order: Baileys first, Malibu next, Drambuie last Serve with a smile (to placate the Leprechauns), wearing no underwear (och!), and thinking of sex (mon). Glug. Whee!

name: Border Crosser
ingredients: 1 - 2 oz tequila|1 oz sweet and sour mix|8 oz Coca-Cola(R)
instructions: You can have a Border Crosser with both ordinary coke and cherry coke.Fill a collins glass part way with ice. Add tequila, sweet and sour mix and fill the remaining space with coca-cola. Mix and serve with a straw.

name: Ruby Port Cobbler
ingredients: 2 1/2 oz ruby port|3 oz club soda|1 tsp superfine sugar
instructions: Dissolve the sugar in the club soda in the bottom of an old-fashioned glass. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full, and stir well. Garnish with a maraschino cherry, a slice of orange, and a slice of lemon.

name: Peppertini
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Stoli(R) Pertsovka vodka|1/2 oz dry vermouth
instructions: Pour the Stoli pepper vodka (Pertsovka) and dry vermouth into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and pour into an old-fashioned glass over several ice cubes. Garnish with an olive, and serve.

name: Banana Tropical
ingredients: 1 Banana|125 gr Yoghurt|2 dl Pineapple juice
instructions: Put all ingredients in a blender and blend for 3 minutes. If the mix isn't liquid enough (depends on the banana), add another shot of pineapple juice. Decorate with a piece of the banana and a piece of a pineapple.

name: Hawaiian Screw
ingredients: 2 oz Vodka|Orange juice|Pineapple juice
instructions: pour over ice in regular glass. Add pineapple and orange juice to taste. Sort of like a regular screwdriver except with a tropical twist! Can also use orange-strawberry juice or any kind of funky fruit combination!

name: Screwdriver with Color
ingredients: Vodka|Orange juice|Kahlua|Ice
instructions: Start with a shot or two (depending on your preference) of vodka in the glass. Add organge juice until its almost full. Then add a shot or two of Kahlua , just until its has a bit of color. Then some ice, and stirr

name: Burning Demon Piss
ingredients: 1 oz Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila|3 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|1 oz Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|1 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|3 oz hot pepper sauce|6 ozburning hot coffee|1 1/2 oz Bacardi(R) white rum
instructions: Pour the Jose Cuervo tequila, Southern Comfort peach liqueur, Captain Morgan spiced rum and Kahlua coffee liqueur into a beer mug. Add hot sauce and an extremely hot cup of coffee, then top with Bacardi and serve.
shopping: Jose Cuervo(R) Especial gold tequila|Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|Captain Morgan(R) Original spiced rum|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|hot pepper sauce|coffee|Bacardi(R) white rum

name: Marilyn's Green Thing
ingredients: 2 oz Bacardi(R) light rum|1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|3/4 oz melon liqueur|1 splash pineapple liqueur|1 1/4 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1 oz Malibu(R) mango rum|1 splash pineapple juice|1 - 2 oz sweet and sour mix
instructions: Fill a pint glass with ice, then add liquors and a splash of pineapple juice. Top off with sour mix, pour everything into a strainer, shake well, pour back into glass. Garnish with a pineapple slice, if available.
shopping: Bacardi(R) light rum|Blue Curacao liqueur|melon liqueur|pineapple liqueur|Malibu(R) coconut rum|Malibu(R) mango rum|pineapple juice|sweet and sour mix

name: Electric Watermelon
ingredients: 1 part Tanqueray(R) Sterling vodka|1 part Bacardi(R) light rum|1 part Midori(R) melon liqueur|2 splashes triple sec|fill with sweet and sour mix|1 splash grenadine syrup|1 splash 7-Up(R) soda
instructions: Add equal parts vodka, rum, and melon liqueur in a tall cocktail glass with ice. Add a couple of splashes of triple sec (orange liquor). Fill to the top with sweet and sour mix. Add a splash of 7-up and grenadine.
shopping: Tanqueray(R) Sterling vodka|Bacardi(R) light rum|Midori(R) melon liqueur|triple sec|sweet and sour mix|grenadine syrup|7-Up(R) soda

name: Arizona Twister
ingredients: 1 shot Vodka (Absolut)|1 shot Malibu rum|1 shot Gold tequila (Cuervo)|1 splash Orange juice|1 splash Pineapple juice|1 splash Cream of coconut|1 dash Grenadine|crushed Ice|1 wedge Pineapple
instructions: Just mix in the shots of rum, vodka, and tequila. Add splashes of the three juices, heavy on the pineapple. Top off with grenadine. Crushed ice should already be in glass. Top off the glass with a pineapple wedge.
shopping: Vodka|Malibu rum|Gold tequila|Orange juice|Pineapple juice|Cream of coconut|Grenadine|Ice|Pineapple

name: Creamsicle Raptor Style
ingredients: 1 - 3 oz Absolut(R) Mandrin vodka|1 oz triple sec|2 oz amaretto almond liqueur|2 oz sweet and sour mix|4 oz orange juice|1 splash soda water
instructions: Combine all mixers but soda water in mixer with ice and shake, pour into high ball glass.  Add the splash of soda water and enjoy.  I recommend experimenting with the quantities of Absolut depending on your taste.
shopping: Absolut(R) Mandrin vodka|triple sec|amaretto almond liqueur|sweet and sour mix|orange juice|soda water

name: Mints-Quick
ingredients: 4 ozwhole milk|1 serving Nesquik(R) chocolate powder|4 oz Bailey's(R) Mint Chocolate Irish cream liqueur|chocolate|chocolate whipped cream
instructions: Combine equal parts of Bailey's and milk. Add nesquick and mix. Top with redi whip and shavings and garnish with a sprig of mint. Serve with ice or heat for a warm treat! For a special desert add Ice cream! YUMMY!
shopping: milk|Nesquik(R) chocolate powder|Bailey's(R) Mint Chocolate Irish cream liqueur|chocolate|whipped cream

name: T.L.C.
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz blended whiskey|1/2 oz Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|1 tsp Ricard(R) pastis|1 tsp Dubonnet(R) Rouge vermouth|1 dash bitters
instructions: Pour the whiskey, Cointreau, Ricard, Dubonnet and bitters into a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes. Stir well, and strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a maraschino cherry and a lemon twist, and serve.
shopping: blended whiskey|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|Ricard(R) pastis|Dubonnet(R) Rouge vermouth|bitters

name: Packerita
ingredients: 4 pieces Ice|1 oz Tequila (Jose Cuervo)|1 oz Triple sec|Fill with Pineapple juice|1 splash Blue Curacao|1 slice Lime (optional)
instructions: Place four ice cubes in a glass. Add tequila and triple sec. Fill almost to top with pineapple juice, and add a splash of Blue Curacao. Squeeze lime wedge over drink (optional). Mix thoroughly and enjoy immensely.

name: Pan Galactic Gargle Blaster
ingredients: 35 cl Tia maria|35 cl Vodka|17.5 cl Cherry brandy|1 dash Lime juice|1/2 glass 7-Up|1/2 glass dry Cider|About 4 Ice cubes
instructions: Take a pintglass (= approx. 0.5 litres) Put the Tia Maria, the vodka and the cherry brandy together. Add a dash of lime juice. Fill the rest of the glass up with (50% - 50%) with dry cider and 7 -up Add ice cubes.

name: Metropolitan #2
ingredients: 1 oz Absolut(R) Citron vodka|1 oz Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|2 ozfresh lime juice|1 oz Ocean Spray(R) cranberry juice
instructions: Build ingredients in a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake and strain carefully into a sugar-rimmed 10-oz cocktail glass so as not to knock sugar off rim. Garnish with a large lemon twist, and serve.
shopping: Absolut(R) Citron vodka|Chambord(R) raspberry liqueur|lime juice|Ocean Spray(R) cranberry juice

name: Cocopolitan
ingredients: 1 1/4 oz Burnett's(R) coconut vodka|1/2 oz Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|3/4 oz cranberry juice|1 twist lime juice
instructions: A tasty puerto rican recipe, similar to that of the Cosmopolitan although with coconut vodka instead. Combine in a shaker all the ingredients and shake. Chill a cocktail glass, pour and serve with a twist of lime.
shopping: Burnett's(R) coconut vodka|Cointreau(R) orange liqueur|cranberry juice|lime juice

name: Constellation
ingredients: 1/2 oz advocaat liqueur|1/2 oz cherry advocaat liqueur|1/2 oz butterscotch schnapps|1 dash Blue Curacao liqueur
instructions: Pour both normal advokaat and cherry advokaat in shot glass at same time, beside each other. Add butterscotch schnappes. Then add dash of blue curacao. There should be no set layers, it should be a mix of colours.
shopping: advocaat liqueur|cherry advocaat liqueur|butterscotch schnapps|Blue Curacao liqueur

name: Jennatini
ingredients: 2 parts Absolut(R) Raspberri vodka|1 part triple sec|3 parts cranberry-raspberry juice|1 squeeze lime juice
instructions: Place ice in shaker, pour vodka and triple sec over ice, add the raspberry cranberry juice and squeeze of key lime juice.  Shake.  Pour into martini glass.  Garnish with orange wheel or twist of lime rind.  Enjoy!
shopping: Absolut(R) Raspberri vodka|triple sec|cranberry-raspberry juice|lime juice

name: Pousse Cafe a la Francaise
ingredients: 1/2 oz Green Chartreuse(R)|1/2 oz maraschino liqueur|1/2 oz cherry brandy|1/2 oz Kummel(R) caraway liqueur
instructions: Pour the chartreuse into a pousse-cafe glass. Carefully float the maraschino liqueur on top by pouring slowly over the back of a teaspoon. Do the same with the cherry brandy, and then again with the kummel. Serve.
shopping: Green Chartreuse(R)|maraschino liqueur|cherry brandy|Kummel(R) caraway liqueur

name: Sand in the Crack
ingredients: 1 oz Malibu(R) coconut rum|1 oz Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|4 oz pineapple juice|1 splash cranberry juice
instructions: Fill the glass with ice.  Put in the Captain and the Malibu.  Pour in the Pineapple juice be sure to leave a little room for the cranberry juice.  The cranberry juice is to make the drink look like a sunset color.
shopping: Malibu(R) coconut rum|Captain Morgan(R) spiced rum|pineapple juice|cranberry juice

name: Sloe Gin Collins
ingredients: 2 oz Sloe gin|Juice of 1/2 Lemon|Carbonated water|1 slice Lemon|1 slice Orange|1 Cherry
instructions: Shake sloe gin and juice of lemon with ice and strain into a collins glass. Add several ice cubes, fill with carbonated water, and stir. Add slices of lemon and orange, top with the cherry, and serve with a straw.

name: A Sunny Delight
ingredients: 1 shot Triple sec|3 shots Lemon vodka|1 shot Club soda|Lemon|Fill with Sunny delight
instructions: Using shot glasses in a cannery style Mason jar, pour the vodka and the triple sec together. Then sqeeze the lemon lightly, and place it on the rim. Fill the glass with Sunny Delight, then add a shot of Club Soda.

name: Apple Colada
ingredients: 2 oz Apple schnapps|1 oz Cream of coconut|1 oz Half-and-half|1 slice Apple|1 Cherry
instructions: Blend schnapps, cream of coconut, half-and-half, and 2 cups of crushed ice in an electric blender at a high speed. Pour contents into a collins glass. Decorate with an apple slice and a cherry. Serve with a straw.

name: Toblerone #2
ingredients: 30 ml Frangelico|15 ml Bailey's irish cream|15 ml Kahlua|75 ml Cream|1 tsp Honey
instructions: Blend ingrediants with ice until a creamy consistancy is reached (don't add too much ice, this will make the drink too thick). Pour into a *HONEY LINED GLASS*. Garnish with chocolate flakes and an open strawberry.

name: Flatliner #3
ingredients: 1 oz Chartreuse(R) herbal liqueur|1 oz gold tequila|1 - 7 drops Tabasco(R) sauce
instructions: Pour the tequila over the chartreuse in a 2-oz shot glass. Add desired amount of tabasco sauce, and serve. (1-2 drops for the weak, 3-4 for the mid-strength, 4-7 for the adventurous, 7+ for the herculean efforts.)

name: Blackberry Punch
ingredients: 1 oz rum|2 oz blackberry liqueur|1 tsp powdered sugar|2 ozfresh lemon juice
instructions: Pour the rum, blackberry liqueur, sugar and lemon juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass filled with ice cubes. Garnish with a lemon wedge, and serve.

name: Butterbeer #2
ingredients: 1/2 pint Mickey Finn's butterscotch and vanilla liqueur|1/2 pint root beer
instructions: Take a pint glass or mug and fill with ice cubes. Half-fill the glass with Mickey Finn's Butterscotch and Vanilla liqueur (available at grocery stores) and fill the rest of the glass with root beer before serving.
shopping: Mickey Finn's butterscotch and vanilla liqueur|root beer

name: Fluffy Pink Slipper
ingredients: 1/2 oz cherry brandy|1 oz coconut milk|1/2 oz sugar syrup|1 oz crushed ice
instructions: Simply shake/whisk/blend proportions of ingredients to taste and serve in a tall cordial glass. The more cherry brandy you add the pinker the slipper becomes. Whereas, the more you whisk the 'fluffier' it becomes.

name: Electric Margarita
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Tequila|1/2 oz Blue Curacao|1/2 oz Rose's sweetened lime juice
instructions: Moisten rim of cocktail glass with lime wedge, and salt rim of glass. In a shaker half filled with ice, combine tequila, blue curacao, and rose's lime juice. Shake well. Strain into glass. Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Jelly Bean #2
ingredients: 1/2 shot Kahlua|1/2 shot Anisette|1/2 shot Bacardi 151 proof rum
instructions: Pour ingredients in the above order into highball glass. Tilt glass until mixture is close to top of glass and light. Wait a few seconds, then right before shooting it, blow it out so you don't burn your face off!

name: Beach Bum Shake
ingredients: 1 oz tequila|2 oz orange juice|1/4 oz vodka|1 splash triple sec
instructions: Pour the tequila, orange juice, vodka and triple sec into a cocktail shaker with crushed ice and shake for about a minute. Strain into hurricane glass. Add a tiny umbrella and slice of lemon (optional), and serve.

name: Starla's Waver
ingredients: 1 tblsp Milk|3 shots Kahlua|5 shots Absolut Vodka|1 tblsp Rum
instructions: Get a large glass, (any glass but it must be large) Start from the top of the list and work your way down stirring each time you add an ingredient. When you've finished you need not do anything else just drink it.

name: Flaming 7-7
ingredients: 2 oz Seagram's(R) 7 whisky|12 oz 7-Up(R) soda
instructions: Pour the Seagram's 7 Crown whiskey into a double-shot glass. Seperately, pour the 7-Up into a highball glass. Ignite the Seagram's 7 on fire (use extreme caution), and drop into the highball glass. Stir and serve.

name: Vodkatini
ingredients: 3 oz vodka
instructions: Stir the vodka with ice in a mixing glass. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, garnish with a pitted cocktail olive, and serve in front with an open bottle of vermouth situated in front of a fan across the room.

name: Blue Bong
ingredients: 2 oz Absolut(R) vodka|2 oz Bombay Sapphire(R) gin|3 oz Jones(R) Blue Bubble-gum soda|2 oz Kool-Aid(R) Blue Raspberry mix|1/3 - 1/2 ozfresh lemon juice
instructions: Combine Absolut, Bombay Sapphire and Kool Aid into a cocktail shaker with ice. Strain into hurricane glass over ice, add Blue Bubblegum Soda on top and squeeze in the lemon. Garnish with a Blueberry in the glass.
shopping: Absolut(R) vodka|Bombay Sapphire(R) gin|Jones(R) Blue Bubble-gum soda|Kool-Aid(R) Blue Raspberry mix|lemon juice

name: Cave In
ingredients: 1 oz amaretto almond liqueur|1 oz Bacardi(R) 151 rum|1 oz Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|1 splash orange juice|cranberry juice
instructions: Pour the amaretto, Bacardi 151 and Southern Comfort into an old-fashioned glass 3/4 filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Add cranberry juice to taste, and stir again briefly. Add a splash of orange juice, and serve.
shopping: amaretto almond liqueur|Bacardi(R) 151 rum|Southern Comfort(R) peach liqueur|orange juice|cranberry juice

name: Apollo 13
ingredients: 2 oz white rum|2 ozfresh cream|1/2 oz Grand Marnier(R) orange liqueur|1/2 oz Galliano(R) herbal liqueur|1 dash grenadine syrup
instructions: Pour the white rum, cream, Grand Marnier, Galliano and grenadine into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice. Shake well. Strain into a 5 oz champagne saucer or glass. Garnish with a maraschino cherry, and serve.
shopping: white rum|cream|Grand Marnier(R) orange liqueur|Galliano(R) herbal liqueur|grenadine syrup

name: Barnstormer
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Canadian whisky|1/2 oz peppermint schnapps|1 tsp dark creme de cacao|1 tsp white creme de cacao|1/2 oz lemon juice
instructions: Pour whisky, peppermint schnapps, creme de cacao liqueurs and lemon juice into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, and serve.
shopping: Canadian whisky|peppermint schnapps|dark creme de cacao|white creme de cacao|lemon juice

name: Darkside Martini
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Grey Goose(R) L'Orange vodka|1 1/2 oz Blue Curacao liqueur|3/4 oz Rose's(R) lime juice|1 1/2 oz cranberry juice
instructions: As first served at now defunct Smith Brothers restaurant in Port Washington, Wisconsin.Pour ingredients into shaker over lots of ice. Shake 37 times, this is critical! Strain into martini glass and sip liberally.
shopping: Grey Goose(R) L'Orange vodka|Blue Curacao liqueur|Rose's(R) lime juice|cranberry juice

name: Smart Bomb
ingredients: 1/2 oz Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|1/2 oz Smirnoff(R) Orange Twist vodka|4 - 6 oz Red Bull(R) energy drink
instructions: The Smart Bomb is a drop-shot created at the Cats Den at Ohio University, it tastes like an orange smartie.Pour the Jager and Orange Vodka into a shot glass and then drop it in a glass or cup of redbull and chug.
shopping: Jagermeister(R) herbal liqueur|Smirnoff(R) Orange Twist vodka|Red Bull(R) energy drink

name: Big Chill #2
ingredients: 1 oz dark rum|1 oz Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|4 ozcold coffee|1 oz cream|1/2 tsp sugar|1 oz vanilla ice cream
instructions: Pour the dark rum, Kahlua, coffee, cream and sugar into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes. Shake well, and strain into a highball glass 2/3 filled with ice cubes. Top with vanilla ice cream, and serve.
shopping: dark rum|Kahlua(R) coffee liqueur|coffee|cream|sugar|vanilla ice cream

name: Diabloow
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz tequila|1 1/2 oz triple sec|1 1/2 oz pineapple juice|3/4 - 1 ozfresh lemon juice|6 oz 7-Up(R) soda
instructions: Frost the rim of a collins glass with salt. Pour the 4 ingredients into a cocktail shaker and shake gently. Pour into the collins glass. Fill with 7-up and garnish with wheel of kiwi fruit and lemon twist. Serve.

name: Applejack Collins

shopping: lemonade|Smirnoff(R) Raspberry Twist vodka|McGuinness(R) blue Curacao liqueur|ice cubes

instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, kirschwasser, apricot brandy, and lemon juice. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with the lemon twist.

shopping: Malibu(R) coconut rum|banana liqueur|half-and-half|orange juice|grenadine syrup

name: Santa's Little Helper

instructions: Pour apple juice into a cocktail shaker. Add Goldschlager, apple schnapps and butterscotch schnapps. Shake and strain into a large cocktail glass. Garnish with an apple slice or cinnamon stick, and serve.
shopping: apple juice|apple schnapps|Goldschlager(R) cinnamon schnapps|butterscotch schnapps

name: The Fuzzy Magnum
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Grenadine|1 1/2 oz Peach schnapps|1 oz Absolut Mandrin|1 oz Triple sec|2 oz Orange juice|1 wedge Lemon
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except lemon wedge) into shaker. Fill glass with ice and pour until about 1/4 inch remains in glass and squeeze lemon wedge into drink then drop lemon wedge in (for color and flavor).

instructions: Pour the Midori, Malibu, Schnapps, and orange juice into a shaker filled halfway with ice. Shake well. Pour into a collins glass and add the grenadine. Garnish with orange wedges and cherries as seen fit.

instructions: Dip the rim of cocktail glass in Amaretto and then into powdered sugar. Shake all alcohol and cream with ice and strain into rimmed cocktail glass. Garnish with Cinnamon stick and whipped cream (optional)

instructions: Pour lime juice until a thin layer covers bottom of the glass. Add strawberry margarita mix and coconut rum, then fill glass with orange juice, stir well. Add cherry and serve. Best when served very cold!
shopping: Malibu(R) coconut rum|lime juice|orange juice|strawberry margarita mix

name: Charro Negro
ingredients: Juice of 1/2 Lemon|1 oz Tequila (Herradura blanco)|4 cubes Ice|Fill with Coca-Cola|Salt
instructions: Rub rim of glass with lemon juice and dip rim in salt. Put 4 ice cubes into the glass, add Tequila and juice of half a lemon. Add some more salt if you like and fill the glass with Coca-COla. Stir gently.

instructions: Becherovka:^^For those who don't know what Becherovka is, then I can say that it's a Czech liqueur, usually served cold as an appetizer to dinner!^^^^Tequila:^^For this drink we used Sierra Tequila Silver
shopping: but I guess any tequila would do...

name: Coolwater
ingredients: 1/2 cup Grey Goose(R) vodka|1/4 cup Hpnotiq(R) liqueur|1/4 cup Monster(R) energy drink
instructions: Fill the cup three quarters of the way with ice. Pour Grey Goose about halfway. Then add the Hpnotiq to a little less than a quarter of the way up. Fill the rest with Monster. Give it a quick stir. Enjoy!
shopping: Grey Goose(R) vodka|Hpnotiq(R) liqueur|Monster(R) energy drink

instructions: Stir lemon juice, sugar and 2 oz of club soda together in a collins glass. Fill the glass with cracked ice. Add rum. Top with club soda, and stir. Garnish with a spiral of orange or lemon peel, and serve.

shopping: DeKuyper(R) Raspberry Pucker schnapps|Red Bull(R) energy drink

name: Applejack Manhattan

shopping: spiced rum|sweet and sour mix|apple juice

instructions: Drain syrup from the fruit cocktail. Mix fruit, cinnamon, and ice in a blender. Add whisky to whisky according to taste. Let blend for about 2 1/2 minuets at high setting.

name: Pink Gin Tonic
ingredients: 2 oz Gin|5 oz Tonic water|1 splash Campari|1 wedge Lime
instructions: Pour the gin and the tonic water into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Top with Campari to add more colour and taste. Garnish with the lime wedge.

name: Balanchine's Belle
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Dubonnet(R) Rouge vermouth|1/2 oz dry vermouth
instructions: Pour the Dubonnet wine and the dry vermouth into a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass, garnish with a lemon twist, and serve.

name: Gin Limey
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz Seagram's(R) Lime Twisted gin|5 oz tonic water
instructions: An interesting twist on the original. For those who like more lime taste, pour Seagram's Lime-Twisted gin over ice and fill with Tonic Water. Garnish with a slice of lime.

name: Bonfire
ingredients: 1/2 oz Grenadine|1/2 oz Amaretto|1/2 oz 151 proof rum
instructions: Layer this drink! Grenadine first, Amaretto next, and 151 on top. Light the 151 and let it warm for about 3 seconds. Blow (lightly) to put the flame out and take the shot.

name: Puerto Rico Breeze
ingredients: 1 oz rum|1 oz creme de almond|6 oz pineapple juice
instructions: Fill a hurricane glass with ice and add the ingredients (you can also blend the ingredients with ice until slushy). Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry, and serve.

name: Hpnotiq Martini
ingredients: 1 oz cherry vodka|2 oz Hpnotiq(R) liqueur
instructions: Add cherry vodka to a cocktail shaker filled with ice, then add Hpnotiq liqueur. Shake, shake, shake. Pour into a cocktail glass and garnish with maraschino cherry. Serve.

name: Popper
ingredients: 1/2 shot Tequila|1/2 shot 7-Up or Sprite
instructions: Pour tequila into shot glass. Fill the rest of glass with 7-up. Cover top of glass with hand and slam hard onto counter or bar. This causes shot to fizz, so drink quickly!

name: Devil's Piss
ingredients: 1 1/2 shot Everclear|Lemonade
instructions: Using a large glass of water, add lemonade concentrate to taste (Best if you make it a little stronger than usual). Add the 1.5 shots of Everclear and be sure to mix well!

name: Wise Bomb

instructions: Pour all whiskeys and irish cream into a 2 oz double-shot glass. Pour half a pint of Guinness into a beer mug or pint glass. Drop the shot glass into the stout, and chug.
